places.name: Vienna
places.why: The Vienna Boys' Choir has sung Sunday Mass in the Hofburg chapel for five centuries
places.realVisit: The Hofburg chapel is in central Vienna; Sunday Mass tickets can be booked

places.name: Noratus
places.why: Armenia's carved khachkars are one of the world's many shapes of the cross
places.realVisit: Noratus is near Gavar, about 90 minutes from Yerevan by car

places.name: Maramureș villages
places.why: In Maramureș faith is kept at home: name days, grace, bedtime prayers, icon corners and house blessings
places.realVisit: Maramureș is reached via Baia Mare or Sighetu Marmației; villages welcome respectful visitors

places.name: Santiago de Compostela
places.why: The Camino de Santiago ends at the apostle's cathedral, the great walk of the Christian world
places.realVisit: Santiago has an airport; the Camino Francés is walked from France over about five weeks

lessons.title: Block close: the house of prayer

places.name: Lisbon
places.why: The 1755 Lisbon earthquake struck on All Saints' Day and made all of Europe ask why there is suffering
places.realVisit: Lisbon's Carmo ruins and cathedral are in the old centre

places.name: Colmar
places.why: The Isenheim Altarpiece painted a suffering Christ for plague patients
places.realVisit: Colmar is half an hour by train from Strasbourg

places.name: Sotome
places.why: Endo's novel Silence is set on this coast where hidden Christians kept faith
places.realVisit: Sotome is an hour from Nagasaki

places.name: Tarsus
places.why: Paul's home town is where to hear his thorn in the flesh and his strength in weakness
places.realVisit: Tarsus is a short drive from Mersin or Adana airport

places.name: Salamanca
places.why: Salamanca's university, where friars taught theology and science side by side, is a place to weigh faith and reason
places.realVisit: Salamanca is 90 minutes by train from Madrid

places.name: Fátima
places.why: Millions come to Fátima seeking healing, a place to ask honestly how God acts beyond nature
places.realVisit: Fátima is 90 minutes by bus from Lisbon

places.name: L'Arche Daybreak
places.why: Henri Nouwen, author of The Wounded Healer, spent his last years living with people with disabilities here
places.realVisit: L'Arche Daybreak in Richmond Hill welcomes visitors by arrangement

places.name: Skellig Michael and the Iveragh coast
places.why: Monks lived alone on a rock in the Atlantic for six centuries, a place to face fear, loneliness and failure
places.realVisit: Boats leave Portmagee for Skellig Michael in summer, weather allowing

lessons.title: Fear not, and the reason why

places.name: South Wales valleys
places.why: Aberfan's children died in 1966 and the valleys held their grief with psalms and hope
places.realVisit: Aberfan and Llandaff are reached by train and bus from Cardiff

places.name: Dresden
places.why: The Frauenkirche, destroyed in 1945 and rebuilt with a cross made in Britain, teaches praying through war
places.realVisit: Dresden is two hours by train from Berlin

places.name: Christchurch
places.why: After the 2011 earthquake the church here built a cathedral of cardboard
places.realVisit: The Transitional Cathedral is in central Christchurch

places.name: Robben Island
places.why: Christians among the prisoners here kept hope and patience through long years
places.realVisit: Ferries leave the V&A Waterfront in Cape Town for Robben Island

places.name: Olympia
places.why: Paul borrowed the athletes' race; here is the original stadium
places.realVisit: Olympia is reached by bus or train from Pyrgos

places.name: Selma
places.why: Marchers crossed this bridge in 1965 singing hymns and praying, courage while afraid
places.realVisit: The bridge is in downtown Selma, Alabama

places.name: Eilenburg
places.why: Pastor Martin Rinkart wrote 'Now thank we all our God' here after burying thousands in plague and war
places.realVisit: Eilenburg is half an hour by train from Leipzig

places.name: Lystra and Iconium (Konya)
places.why: Paul was stoned at Lystra and hounded from Iconium, the places of his sufferings list
places.realVisit: Konya has an airport; Sille and Kilistra are short drives

places.name: Chichester
places.why: A stone tomb of a knight and lady holding hands inspired Larkin's line that what will survive of us is love
places.realVisit: Chichester is 90 minutes by train from London

places.name: Jerusalem's Old City: fortress and praetorium
places.why: The Roman fortress quarter holds Jesus' trial, the sealed tomb, and Paul's arrest and defense.
places.realVisit: The Via Dolorosa starts near the Lions' Gate; the Sisters of Zion convent shows the Roman pavement.

places.name: Chapel of the Ascension
places.why: The summit of the Mount of Olives, where the risen Christ left the disciples and promised the Spirit.
places.realVisit: The Chapel of the Ascension is at the top of the Mount of Olives in at-Tur, open most days for a small fee.

places.name: Jerusalem of the first deacons
places.why: Where the first deacons served, Stephen preached and died, and James led the council.
places.realVisit: These churches lie in and just outside the Old City; the Armenian Quarter and Nablus Road are walkable.

lessons.spot: Church of St John the Baptist, Muristan
lessons.title: The widows' complaint (Acts 6:1–7)

lessons.spot: Greek Orthodox Church of St Stephen, Kidron
lessons.title: Lord Jesus, receive my spirit (Acts 7:54–8:3)

places.name: Ein Hanniya spring
places.why: Byzantine pilgrims remembered this spring on the road south as where Philip baptized the Ethiopian official.
places.realVisit: Ein Hanniya is a park in the Refaim Valley southwest of Jerusalem, reachable by car or the hiking trail.

places.name: Paphos
places.why: Barnabas and Saul, set apart in Antioch, preached here before Cyprus' Roman governor.
places.realVisit: Paphos is on Cyprus' west coast, with direct flights; St Paul's Pillar sits at the Chrysopolitissa church.

places.name: Pisidian Antioch
places.why: Paul's first long sermon was in this Roman colony; it was a heart of the Galatian churches he wrote to.
places.realVisit: Pisidian Antioch is an archaeological site just outside Yalvaç in Turkey's Isparta province.

places.name: Lystra
places.why: Crowds called Paul and Barnabas gods here, and Timothy grew up here in a house of faith.
places.realVisit: Lystra's unexcavated mound is near Hatunsaray village, a drive south of Konya.

places.name: Berea (Veria)
places.why: The Bereans searched the scriptures daily to test what Paul said.
places.realVisit: Veria is about an hour west of Thessaloniki, with the Bema of St Paul in the old town.

places.name: Alexandria Troas
places.why: At Troas a young man fell asleep at Paul's long sermon; Paul passed through again in his letters.
places.realVisit: Alexandria Troas is near Dalyan village south of Çanakkale, an unfenced site in farmland.

places.name: Miletus
places.why: Paul said farewell to the Ephesian elders here, knelt on the beach and sailed on.
places.realVisit: Miletus is south of Ephesus near Didim, open daily.

places.name: Fair Havens, Crete
places.why: Paul's ship sheltered at Fair Havens before sailing into the storm.
places.realVisit: Kaloi Limenes is a small village on Crete's south coast, a winding drive from Heraklion.

places.name: St Paul's Bay, Malta
places.why: Shipwrecked Paul broke bread on deck and was welcomed by Malta's islanders.
places.realVisit: St Paul's Bay is on Malta's north coast; St Paul's Grotto is in Rabat.

places.name: Basilica of St Paul Outside the Walls
places.why: Paul reached Rome and preached unhindered; tradition places his martyrdom and tomb here.
places.realVisit: St Paul Outside the Walls is on Via Ostiense in Rome, reached by Metro B (Basilica San Paolo).

lessons.spot: Tomb of St Paul under the high altar
lessons.title: Unhindered (Acts 28:17–31)
I have finished the race (2 Timothy 4:6–8)

places.name: Acrocorinth
places.why: From the fortress hill over Corinth, Paul's words on temples, bodies and freedom come alive.
places.realVisit: Acrocorinth is a steep walk or drive above Ancient Corinth, open daily.

lessons.title: Your body is a temple (1 Corinthians 6:12–20)

places.name: Isthmia
places.why: Paul's runners and strong consciences come from the Isthmian games held here.
places.realVisit: The Isthmia site and museum are near the Corinth Canal, along the old national road.

lessons.title: All things to all people (1 Corinthians 9:19–27)

places.name: Ankara (ancient Ancyra)
places.why: Ancyra was the capital of Roman Galatia, the region whose churches Paul wrote to with fire.
places.realVisit: Ankara is Turkey's capital; the Temple of Augustus and Roman baths are in the Ulus district.

places.name: Tel Shiloh
places.why: The tabernacle stood at Shiloh for centuries; Hebrews reads Jesus through that tent and its priests.
places.realVisit: Ancient Shiloh is a heritage site in Samaria with a visitor centre and film.

lessons.spot: Jami' al-Yetaim on the Byzantine church, Shiloh
lessons.title: Tested like us (Hebrews 2:14–18)

places.name: Rome's catacombs
places.why: The early Christians of Rome buried their dead in hope here; Hebrews and 1 Peter were read in this church.
places.realVisit: The catacombs of San Callisto and San Sebastiano are on the Appia Antica park; Priscilla is on Via Salaria.

lessons.spot: Catacombs of Sant'Agnese fuori le Mura
lessons.title: The same forever (Hebrews 13:1–8)

lessons.spot: Catacombs of Saints Marcellinus and Peter
lessons.title: A living hope (1 Peter 1:3–9)

places.name: Rome of Peter
places.why: Peter wrote from Rome; its old churches keep his chains, his prison and his tomb, and early Roman voices.
places.realVisit: These churches are open to visitors across central Rome, all reachable on foot or by Metro.

lessons.spot: Basilica of Santi Nereo e Achilleo
lessons.title: The Shepherd of Hermas

places.name: Bemerton
places.why: George Herbert, poet and country parson, wrote 'Prayer' and 'The Elixir' at Bemerton.
places.realVisit: Bemerton is a village on the edge of Salisbury, a short walk from the city.

lessons.spot: Church of St Mary and St Nicholas, Wilton
lessons.title: Prayer, the church's banquet

places.name: Bedford and Elstow
places.why: John Bunyan lived, preached and was jailed here, and wrote The Pilgrim's Progress.
places.realVisit: Bedford is an hour north of London by train; Elstow is two miles south.

places.name: Nashville
places.why: The Fisk Jubilee Singers carried the spirituals to the world from Nashville.
places.realVisit: Fisk University is open to visitors in north Nashville.

lessons.spot: Civil Rights Room, Nashville Public Library
lessons.title: Were you there?

places.name: St Beuno's, North Wales
places.why: Gerard Manley Hopkins wrote 'God's Grandeur' at St Beuno's.
places.realVisit: St Beuno's Jesuit spirituality centre is near Tremeirchion and hosts retreats.

places.name: Lisieux
places.why: Thérèse of Lisieux found her little way and her vocation to love here.
places.realVisit: Lisieux is two hours from Paris by train; Les Buissonnets and the basilica are open.

lessons.title: Love is my vocation (Story of a Soul)

places.name: Beaconsfield
places.why: G.K. Chesterton lived and wrote with gratitude in Beaconsfield.
places.realVisit: Beaconsfield is a short train ride from London Marylebone.

places.name: South Uist
places.why: Carmina Gadelica's blessings were gathered from Hebridean homes like these.
places.realVisit: South Uist is reached by ferry from Oban or by plane from Glasgow.

lessons.spot: Our Lady of the Isles statue
lessons.title: A blessing from the Highlands

places.name: Kylemore Abbey
places.why: Benedictine nuns kept prayer, work and hospitality at Kylemore for a century.
places.realVisit: Kylemore Abbey is in Connemara, County Galway, open daily.

places.name: Ely Cathedral
places.why: The 'ship of the Fens' keeps evening prayer and compline above the flat lands.
places.realVisit: Ely is an hour from London by train; evensong is sung most days.

places.name: Harlem
places.why: Harlem's churches show the shape of a Christian week: worship, rest, small groups, fasting and shared meals.
places.realVisit: Harlem is in upper Manhattan, reached by subway; many churches welcome visitors.

lessons.spot: Canaan Baptist Church of Christ, Harlem
lessons.title: Sunday worship

lessons.spot: Cathedral of St John the Divine
lessons.title: A fast day

places.name: Montserrat
places.why: Montserrat's mountain monastery welcomes retreatants and pilgrims all year.
places.realVisit: Montserrat is an hour from Barcelona by train and rack railway.

places.name: Tibhirine
places.why: The Trappist monks of Tibhirine lived as friends with their Muslim neighbors.
places.realVisit: Our Lady of Atlas at Tibhirine, near Médéa, can be visited with local arrangement.

lessons.spot: Our Lady of Atlas monastery garden
lessons.title: Friends of other beliefs

places.name: Lower Manhattan
places.why: Wall Street's old churches stand for faith at work, money and time.
places.realVisit: Trinity Church and St Paul's Chapel are open daily in Lower Manhattan.

places.name: Washington, D.C.
places.why: America's capital is a fitting place to ask how Christians live as citizens who seek justice and peace.
places.realVisit: These sites are in Washington, D.C., reachable by Metro.

places.name: Jerusalem lookouts
places.why: Looking back at the first years from the high places around Jerusalem.
places.realVisit: Jerusalem's lookouts are open to the public.

lessons.spot: Tomb of the Virgin Mary, Kidron
lessons.title: Mary, looking back

places.name: Sea of Galilee shores
places.why: Coming back to the lake where the story began.
places.realVisit: The lake is circled by Route 90 and Route 92.

places.name: Istanbul
places.why: Istanbul's museums and churches look back on Israel's story, the early church and the middle centuries.
places.realVisit: Istanbul is a major travel hub.

places.name: Kyiv
places.why: Kyiv's lavra and cathedral keep the feasts, doctrines and prayer of the East.
places.realVisit: Kyiv's lavra and St Sophia can be visited when travel is safe.

lessons.title: The ways of prayer, looking back

places.name: St. Patrick's Cathedral, New York
places.why: First steps into Catholic practice in a big-city parish anyone can walk into.
places.realVisit: Open daily on Fifth Avenue in Manhattan; walk in for free and stay for a weekday Mass.

lessons.spot: Bronze doors and holy water fonts, Fifth Avenue entrance
lessons.title: the smallest prayer

lessons.spot: Carved confessionals along the north aisle
lessons.title: the most misunderstood room in the building

lessons.spot: Altar of St. Elizabeth Ann Seton
lessons.title: honor, not worship

places.name: San Fernando Cathedral, San Antonio
places.why: Mexican-American home faith: medals, candles and grace at the family table.
places.realVisit: Downtown San Antonio, Texas; free to enter, and the Missions trail is a short drive south.

lessons.spot: Market Square (El Mercado) religious goods stalls
lessons.title: the things your family kept

places.name: Basilica of the Annunciation, Nazareth
places.why: Mary's home town, where the yes was said and Jesus grew up in a workshop.
places.realVisit: Fly to Tel Aviv, then a bus or tour to Nazareth; the basilica is free and open daily.

lessons.spot: Grotto of the Annunciation, lower church
lessons.title: a young woman says yes

lessons.spot: St. Gabriel's Church over Mary's Well
lessons.title: the words, line by line, from Luke

lessons.spot: Nazareth Village open-air farm and workshop
lessons.title: The hidden years

lessons.spot: Synagogue Church in the old market
lessons.title: The carpenter (Mark 6:1–6)

places.name: Mount of Olives
places.why: The hill facing the Temple where Jesus taught his prayer, rode down on Palm Sunday and went up.
places.realVisit: A short walk or taxi east of Jerusalem's Old City; the churches open mornings and afternoons.

lessons.spot: Pater Noster Church cloister, the Lord's Prayer tiles
lessons.title: the family word he chose

lessons.spot: Palm Sunday road down the Mount of Olives
lessons.title: The fig tree and the temple (Mark 11:1–25)

places.name: Notre-Dame de Paris
places.why: The Mass in a great cathedral reborn: the book, the peace, the Sunday bells, the candles.
places.realVisit: Free entry on the Île de la Cité in central Paris; timed reservations help in summer.

lessons.title: why people stand up when the book comes in

lessons.spot: The transept crossing under the rose windows
lessons.title: "peace be with you"
the obligation nobody explains as a gift

lessons.spot: Virgin of Paris statue and candle stands
lessons.title: why there's fire in every church

places.name: Sea of Galilee shore at Magdala
places.why: The lakeshore of Magdala and Ginosar, where the boats, the storms and Mary Magdalene's home town meet.
places.realVisit: Magdala and Ginosar sit on the lake's west shore near Tiberias; both welcome visitors daily.

lessons.spot: Boat Altar, Duc in Altum chapel
lessons.title: Launch out into the deep (Luke 5:1–11)

lessons.spot: Ancient Galilee Boat, Yigal Allon Centre, Ginosar
lessons.title: Peace, be still (Mark 4:35–41)
Camp 4 close: he goes before you (Mark 16)

places.name: Basilica of St. Francis, Assisi
places.why: Francis and Clare's town, where the Gospel was lived out loud.
places.realVisit: Train to Assisi from Rome or Florence, then a bus up the hill; churches are free.

lessons.spot: Sanctuary of the Renunciation (Santa Maria Maggiore, Assisi)
lessons.title: the rich kid who gave his clothes back

lessons.spot: Crypt and tomb of St. Francis
lessons.title: the word Pope Francis kept saying

lessons.spot: Lower Piazza of the Basilica, site of the 1986 Day of Prayer for Peace
lessons.title: Other religions (Nostra Aetate, 1965)

places.name: Ávila, walled city of St. Teresa
places.why: St. Teresa's walled city, where prayer became a friendship and the Interior Castle took shape.
places.realVisit: Train from Madrid to Ávila in about 90 minutes; walk the walls and visit Teresa's convents.

lessons.spot: Convento de Santa Teresa, her birthplace
lessons.title: the saint who wrote about prayer like a friendship

lessons.spot: Puerta del Alcázar gate in the walls
lessons.title: The second rooms

lessons.spot: Convent of San José, Teresa's first reform house
lessons.title: The third rooms

places.name: Ein Karem
places.why: The hill village of Elizabeth and Zechariah, where Mary sang and John was born.
places.realVisit: A short bus ride west of central Jerusalem; walk between the churches on village lanes.

lessons.spot: Magnificat wall, Church of the Visitation courtyard
lessons.title: My soul doth magnify (Luke 1:46–55)

lessons.spot: Church of St. John the Baptist, birth grotto
lessons.title: Thou hast searched me (Psalm 138 [139])

lessons.spot: Upper Church of the Visitation, painted walls
lessons.title: Let every spirit praise the Lord (Psalm 150)

places.name: Milk Grotto, Bethlehem
places.why: Bethlehem's streets, where the census ended in a full town and the family fled at night.
places.realVisit: Bethlehem is a short drive from Jerusalem through the checkpoint; local guides lead walks.

places.name: Shepherds' Field, Beit Sahour
places.why: The fields and hills east of Bethlehem where shepherds heard the news and psalms were sung.
places.realVisit: Beit Sahour is just east of Bethlehem; the Franciscan site and caves are open to visitors.

places.name: Southern Steps of the Temple Mount
places.why: The Temple's great stairs and gates, where Jesus was presented, lost, found and taught.
places.realVisit: The Jerusalem Archaeological Park by the Dung Gate is open daily with a ticket.

lessons.spot: Ophel excavations below the Southern Wall
lessons.title: Lost for three days (Luke 2:41–52)

lessons.spot: Ritual baths (mikvaot) by the Southern Steps
lessons.title: Neither do I condemn thee (John 8:1–11)

lessons.spot: Southern Steps, the pilgrims' steps of ascent
lessons.title: Songs of the road (Psalm 120 [121])

lessons.spot: Herodian street along the Western Wall
lessons.title: Render to Caesar (Mark 11:27–12:17)

places.name: Baptism site on the Jordan (Qasr al-Yahud)
places.why: The river where John called people to turn around and Jesus stepped into the water.
places.realVisit: Qasr al-Yahud is reached by road from Jericho; the Jordan side, Al-Maghtas, from Amman.

lessons.spot: Elijah's Hill, Bethany beyond the Jordan
lessons.title: Looking on him, loved him (Mark 10:17–31)

places.name: Judean Wilderness, Mount of Temptation
places.why: The desert where Jesus fasted forty days and was tested.
places.realVisit: A cable car runs from Jericho up to the Monastery of the Temptation.

lessons.spot: Summit of the Mount of Temptation (Jebel Quruntul)
lessons.title: Straight into the desert (Mark 1:9–13)

places.name: Kafr Kanna (Cana)
places.why: The village of the wedding where the wine ran out and Mary spoke up.
places.realVisit: Kafr Kanna is a few kilometres from Nazareth; the Wedding Church is open daily.

places.name: Capernaum
places.why: Jesus' home base by the lake: Peter's house, the synagogue and the street.
places.realVisit: On the north shore of the Sea of Galilee; open daily with a small entrance fee.

lessons.spot: Memorial church over St. Peter's House
lessons.title: Through the roof (Mark 2:1–12)

lessons.spot: Road stones by the Capernaum gate
lessons.title: The tax collector's table (Matthew 9:9–13)

lessons.spot: Garden of ancient millstones and olive presses
lessons.title: Little girl, arise (Mark 5:21–43)

lessons.spot: Statue of St. Peter with the keys
lessons.title: If thou wilt (Mark 1:40–45)

lessons.spot: Basalt foundations of the first-century synagogue
lessons.title: Sins first (Mark 2:1–12)

lessons.spot: Greek Orthodox Church of the Seven Apostles
lessons.title: Who is my mother (Mark 3:20–35)

places.name: Jacob's Well, Nablus
places.why: The well where a Samaritan woman had the longest conversation with Jesus in the Gospels.
places.realVisit: In Nablus, reachable with local West Bank tour guides; the Orthodox church keeps the well open.

lessons.spot: Jacob's Well crypt, Bir Ya'qub church
lessons.title: The woman at the well (John 4:1–42)

places.name: Church of the Multiplication, Tabgha
places.why: The springs of Tabgha, where parables were told from a boat and bread was multiplied.
places.realVisit: On the north-west shore between Capernaum and Ginosar; the church is free and open daily.

lessons.title: The mustard seed and the yeast (Matthew 13:31–33)

lessons.spot: Loaves-and-fishes mosaic, Church of the Multiplication
lessons.title: Five loaves and two fish (John 6:1–14)

lessons.spot: Wheat fields on the slope above Tabgha
lessons.title: The sabbath was made for man (Mark 2:13–28)
The seed that grows while you sleep (Mark 4:21–34)

places.name: Wadi Qelt and St. George's Monastery
places.why: The steep road down from Jerusalem to Jericho, setting of the Good Samaritan and the lost ones found.
places.realVisit: Hike the wadi trail or drive to the monastery overlook from the Jericho road.

lessons.spot: Inn of the Good Samaritan museum
lessons.title: The good Samaritan (Luke 10:25–37)

lessons.spot: Shepherds' trail along the wadi rim
lessons.title: The lost sheep and the lost coin (Luke 15:1–10)

places.name: Jericho
places.why: The oasis city at the bottom of the road, with its date groves, its sycamore and its blind beggar.
places.realVisit: Jericho is a short drive from Jerusalem; local guides show the sycamore and the tel.

places.name: Caesarea Philippi (Banias)
places.why: The springs at the foot of Mount Hermon where Peter answered who Jesus is and the mountain shone.
places.realVisit: Banias Nature Reserve in the northern Golan is open daily; Hermon is a short drive up.

lessons.spot: Grotto of Pan at the Banias spring
lessons.title: Who do you say I am (Mark 8:27–38)

places.name: Bethany (al-Eizariya)
places.why: The home of Martha, Mary and Lazarus, a friend's house just over the hill.
places.realVisit: East of the Mount of Olives; reachable from Jerusalem by taxi or with a West Bank guide.

lessons.spot: Excavated house remains beside the Franciscan church
lessons.title: Martha and Mary (Luke 10:38–42)

lessons.spot: Greek Orthodox Church of St. Lazarus
lessons.title: What she hath done (Mark 14:1–11)

places.name: Mount Zion, Jerusalem
places.why: The hill of the upper room traditions, Peter's denial and the first community at Pentecost.
places.realVisit: Walk out through Zion Gate from the Old City; the churches open daily.

lessons.spot: St. Mark's Syriac Orthodox Church (traditional upper room)
lessons.title: The upper room (Mark 14:12–31)

places.name: Garden of Gethsemane, Mount of Olives
places.why: The olive garden where Jesus prayed not my will but yours.
places.realVisit: At the foot of the Mount of Olives across from the Lions' Gate; free entry.

lessons.spot: Rock of the Agony, Church of All Nations
lessons.title: Gethsemane (Matthew 26:36–46)

places.name: Via Dolorosa
places.why: The Way of the Cross through the Old City: trial, road, crucifixion and the silent Saturday.
places.realVisit: Walk the stations from the Lions' Gate; Franciscans lead a procession every Friday afternoon.

lessons.spot: Ecce Homo arch and Lithostrotos pavement
lessons.title: Before Pilate (John 18:28–19:16)

lessons.spot: Station IX by the Coptic Patriarchate
lessons.title: Remember me (Luke 23:32–43)

lessons.spot: Armenian Catholic Church of Our Lady of the Spasm, Station IV
lessons.title: His mother stood (John 19:25–27)

lessons.spot: Church of the Redeemer bell tower view
lessons.title: It is finished (Luke 23:44–56)

lessons.spot: Station V, Simon of Cyrene chapel
lessons.title: Truly this man (Mark 15:21–47)

places.name: Emmaus Nicopolis
places.why: The Emmaus traditions west of Jerusalem: a garden at dawn, a road at evening, bread broken.
places.realVisit: Emmaus Nicopolis and Abu Ghosh lie off the Tel Aviv–Jerusalem highway; Qubeibeh via West Bank guides.

lessons.spot: Abbey of the Resurrection garden, Abu Ghosh
lessons.title: Mary Magdalene in the garden (John 20:1–18)

places.name: St. Anne's Church and the Pools of Bethesda
places.why: The traditional home of Mary's parents, by the gate where Stephen was stoned.
places.realVisit: Inside the Lions' Gate in the Old City; small entry fee, famous for its echo when you sing.

lessons.spot: Church of the Tomb of Mary, Kidron Valley
lessons.title: Seven sorrows

places.name: Straight Street and the Chapel of Ananias, Damascus
places.why: The street called Straight, where a blinded persecutor was taken in and baptized.
places.realVisit: Damascus's Old City; check travel advisories before planning a visit.

places.name: St. Peter's Church, Jaffa
places.why: The port where Peter saw the vision on the rooftop and was called to a Roman's house.
places.realVisit: Old Jaffa is part of Tel Aviv; walk up from the port.

lessons.spot: House of Simon the Tanner rooftop lane
lessons.title: Peter and Cornelius (Acts 10)

places.name: Ephesus and the House of the Virgin Mary
places.why: The city of the council that named Mary Mother of God, and the house tradition says she lived in.
places.realVisit: Fly to Izmir and drive to Selçuk; the ruins and Mary's House are open daily.

lessons.spot: Church of Mary, council church of 431
lessons.title: Mother of God (Council of Ephesus, 431)

places.name: Metropolitan Cathedral, Mexico City
places.why: Bishop Zumárraga's cathedral, where Juan Diego's cloak was opened and the image was found.
places.realVisit: On the Zócalo in central Mexico City; the Basilica of Guadalupe is a metro ride north.

places.name: Milan Cathedral (St. Ambrose's city)

places.realVisit: Taxis climb the switchback road to the summit basilica from Dabburiya; the views are best at sunrise.

lessons.spot: Summit lookout over the Jezreel Valley
lessons.title: Deborah under the palm (Judges 4–5)

lessons.spot: Greek Orthodox Monastery of Elijah, Mount Tabor
lessons.title: Theosis (CCC 460)

places.name: Valley of Elah
places.why: The Shephelah valleys of Samson and of David's stand against Goliath.
places.realVisit: The Valley of Elah is 30 minutes southwest of Jerusalem; Khirbet Qeiyafa has a marked trail.

places.name: Shepherds' fields of Beit Sahour
places.why: Ruth gleaned in Boaz's fields and David kept sheep here before he was anointed.
places.realVisit: Beit Sahour is next to Bethlehem; the Shepherds' Field sites are a short taxi ride from Manger Square.

places.name: Tel Shiloh
places.why: The tabernacle stood at Shiloh, where Hannah prayed and Samuel heard his name.
places.realVisit: Tel Shiloh is north of Jerusalem off Route 60, with a visitor centre and film.

lessons.title: Saul, head and shoulders taller (1 Samuel 9–10)

places.name: En Gedi
places.why: David hid in the caves of En Gedi; the oasis is a fitting place for the Bible's wisdom.
places.realVisit: En Gedi Nature Reserve is on Route 90 beside the Dead Sea, open daily.

places.name: City of David, Jerusalem
places.why: David's city, Solomon's Temple hill, Isaiah's and Hezekiah's Jerusalem, and the Pool of Siloam.
places.realVisit: The City of David park is just outside the Dung Gate; the water tunnel walk needs sandals and a torch.

lessons.spot: Givati excavation lookout toward the Temple Mount
lessons.title: The Temple (1 Kings 8)

places.name: Mount Carmel, Stella Maris
places.why: Elijah's mountain, home of the Carmelites, where fire fell on the sacrifice.
places.realVisit: Stella Maris is on Haifa's Carmel ridge, reachable by cable car; Muhraqa is a short drive southeast.

lessons.spot: Muhraqa, Carmelite Monastery of the Sacrifice
lessons.title: Fire on Carmel (1 Kings 18)

places.name: Baptism site on the Jordan (Qasr al-Yahud) (second visit)
places.why: At the Jordan, Elijah was taken up, Naaman was healed, and John baptized Jesus.
places.realVisit: Qasr al-Yahud (west bank) and Al-Maghtas (Jordan) are both open to visitors; dress modestly.

lessons.spot: Deir Hajla, Monastery of St Gerasimos near the Jordan
lessons.title: Naaman (2 Kings 5)

lessons.spot: Church of St John the Baptist, Al-Maghtas
lessons.title: Share your coat (Luke 3:1–20)

lessons.spot: Bethany beyond the Jordan baptism pools
lessons.title: Come and see (John 1:29–39)

places.name: Babylon and the Hillah plain (second visit)
places.why: The exile, Ezekiel's vision, the three young men and the fall of Babylon all belong to this plain.
places.realVisit: Babylon is near Hillah, about two hours south of Baghdad; al-Kifl is a short drive further.

places.name: St. Patrick's Cathedral, New York (second visit)
places.why: New York carries Isaiah's peace on the UN's walls, Dorothy Day's houses of hospitality, and St Patrick's.
places.realVisit: All these spots are walkable in Manhattan; St Patrick's is open daily on Fifth Avenue.

lessons.spot: Swords into Plowshares statue, UN garden
lessons.title: Swords into ploughshares (Isaiah 2:4)

lessons.spot: Church of the Nativity, Second Avenue
lessons.title: Doers of the word (James 1:19–27)

lessons.spot: Fifth Avenue parade route at St Patrick's
lessons.title: Saint Patrick (17 March)

places.name: Fishamble Street, Dublin
places.why: Handel's Messiah, which made Isaiah's comfort and suffering servant famous, premiered here.
places.realVisit: Fishamble Street is beside Christ Church Cathedral in central Dublin; Messiah is sung there each April.

places.name: Jerusalem of Jeremiah
places.why: Jeremiah was born at Anathoth and wept over Jerusalem's fall.
places.realVisit: All spots are in or near the Old City; Anata is a short drive northeast.

places.name: Tekoa wilderness
places.why: The herdsman-prophet Amos came from Tekoa, at the edge of the wilderness where prophets spoke.
places.realVisit: Tekoa and Herodium are southeast of Bethlehem; Herodium National Park is open daily.

places.name: Old Jaffa (second visit)
places.why: Jonah sailed from Joppa, and Peter raised Tabitha here.
places.realVisit: Old Jaffa is at the south end of Tel Aviv's beach promenade, walkable from the city.

lessons.spot: Russian Church of St Peter and Tabitha's tomb, Abu Kabir
lessons.title: Tabitha, arise (Acts 9:36–42)

places.name: Wadi Rum
places.why: In the immense desert of Edom, Job's questions and God's whirlwind find their scale.
places.realVisit: Wadi Rum is four hours south of Amman; Bedouin camps offer jeep tours and nights under the stars.

lessons.spot: Rum valley floor below Jebel Rum
lessons.title: Job loses everything (Job 1–2)

places.name: Alexandria
places.why: The Greek Old Testament with its seven extra books, and the Book of Wisdom, came from Alexandria.
places.realVisit: Alexandria is a 2.5-hour train ride from Cairo; the Bibliotheca and Qaitbay are on the Corniche.

places.name: Hamadan (ancient Ecbatana)
places.why: Tobias and the angel Raphael journeyed to Ecbatana, today's Hamadan.
places.realVisit: Hamadan is a five-hour drive or short flight from Tehran.

places.name: Catacombs of St. Callixtus, Rome
places.why: The early Christians buried and prayed for their dead in these catacombs.
places.realVisit: The Catacombs of St Callixtus are on the Appian Way in Rome, visited by guided tour.

lessons.spot: Crypts of Lucina, fish and bread fresco
lessons.title: The catacombs and the fish

lessons.spot: Crypt of St Cornelius with Cyprian fresco
lessons.title: Cornelius and Cyprian (16 September)

lessons.spot: San Callisto in Trastevere, well of his martyrdom
lessons.title: Callistus (14 October)

places.name: Basilica of Santa Maria Maggiore (second visit)
places.why: Rome's great basilica of Mary, with the Luke icon, the Christmas crib and the calendar's meridian nearby.
places.realVisit: Santa Maria Maggiore is a short walk from Rome Termini station; the other spots are walkable.

lessons.spot: Arnolfo di Cambio's Nativity, Sixtine Chapel of Santa Maria Maggiore
lessons.title: An orderly account (Luke 1:1–4)

lessons.spot: Meridian line, Santa Maria degli Angeli
lessons.title: How the calendar works

lessons.spot: Nave mosaics of Santa Maria Maggiore
lessons.title: First Sunday of Advent (Mark 13:33–37)

lessons.spot: Crypt of the Holy Crib (Sacra Culla)
lessons.title: Advent with Isaiah

lessons.spot: Column of the Immaculate Conception, Piazza Mignanelli
lessons.title: The Immaculate Conception (8 December)

places.name: Southern Steps of the Temple Mount (second visit)
places.why: The Temple's great southern stairs, where Zechariah served, Simeon waited and the apostles preached.
places.realVisit: The Southern Steps are inside the Davidson Center archaeological park by the Dung Gate.

lessons.spot: Herodian staircase of the Southern Steps
lessons.title: Simeon's song (Luke 2:22–40)
The truth shall make you free (John 8:31–32)
Silver and gold I have none (Acts 3:1–10)

places.name: Basilica of the Annunciation, Nazareth (second visit)
places.why: Mary's yes, Jesus's hidden years and his first sermon all happened in Nazareth.
places.realVisit: Nazareth is two hours north of Jerusalem by bus; the basilica and St Joseph's are side by side.

lessons.spot: First-century house under the Sisters of Nazareth convent
lessons.title: Hail, full of grace (Luke 1:26–38)

lessons.spot: Nebi Sa'in ridge lookout above Nazareth
lessons.title: He grew (Luke 2:41–52)

lessons.spot: Basilica of Jesus the Adolescent, Nazareth
lessons.title: The Holy Family

places.name: Ein Karem (second visit)
places.why: The hill town of John the Baptist's birth, where Zechariah's Benedictus was sung.
places.realVisit: Ein Karem is a short bus or taxi ride from central Jerusalem.

lessons.spot: Benedictus courtyard, Church of St John the Baptist
lessons.title: Zachary's song (Luke 1:57–80)

lessons.spot: Monastery of St John in the Wilderness (Even Sapir)
lessons.title: The Birth of John the Baptist (24 June)

places.name: Church of the Nativity, Bethlehem
places.why: Bethlehem, where Christ was born, the Innocents mourned and Christmas is kept at midnight.
places.realVisit: Bethlehem is 20 minutes from Jerusalem by bus; enter the basilica through the low Door of Humility.

lessons.spot: Star Street, the old pilgrim way into Bethlehem
lessons.title: Bethlehem, read slowly (Luke 2:1–20)

lessons.spot: Grotto of the Nativity, silver star
lessons.title: Midnight Mass (Luke 2:1–14)

lessons.spot: Cloister of St Catherine's Church, Jerome statue
lessons.title: Ignorance of scripture
John of Damascus and the icons

lessons.spot: Church of St. Nicholas, Beit Jala
lessons.title: Twelve days

places.name: Sea of Galilee shore at Magdala (second visit)
places.why: Magdala, home of Mary Magdalene, and the lake where Peter fell at Jesus' knees.
places.realVisit: Magdala is on the lake road north of Tiberias; the Jesus Boat is at Kibbutz Ginosar nearby.

lessons.spot: Tiberias old harbor where fishing boats moor
lessons.title: Depart from me (Luke 5:1–11)

lessons.spot: Excavated first-century market street of Magdala
lessons.title: She loved much (Luke 7:36–50)

places.name: Mount of Beatitudes (second visit)
places.why: The hillside of the Sermon on the Mount, which Luke sets on a plain.
places.realVisit: The Mount of Beatitudes is above Tabgha; a footpath leads down to the lake.

lessons.spot: Gennesaret plain fields below the hills
lessons.title: Blessed are you poor (Luke 6:20–26)

places.name: Church of the Multiplication, Tabgha (second visit)
places.why: Near Tabgha and Bethsaida the crowds were fed, and the risen Jesus cooked fish on the shore.
places.realVisit: Tabgha lies on the north shore between Capernaum and Ginosar; Bethsaida is a short drive east.

lessons.spot: Beteiha plain on the north-east shore
lessons.title: Take nothing (Luke 9:1–17)

places.name: Mount Arbel and the Galilee fields
places.why: The fields, trails and synagogues of the Galilee where Jesus taught as he walked.
places.realVisit: Arbel National Park is west of the lake; the Jesus Trail passes through it on foot.

lessons.spot: Jesus Trail through the Arbel valley
lessons.title: The seventy-two (Luke 10:1–24)

lessons.spot: Wildflower slopes of the Horns of Hattin
lessons.title: Consider the lilies (Luke 12:22–34)

places.name: Mount of Olives (second visit)
places.why: From Bethphage to Bethany, the Mount of Olives holds Jesus' tears, Lazarus and the Ascension.
places.realVisit: Walk up from the Kidron Valley or take a taxi to the top and walk down the Palm Sunday road.

lessons.spot: Fig orchards on the eastern slope
lessons.title: One more year (Luke 13:6–9)

lessons.spot: Tomb of the Prophets Haggai and Malachi, Mount of Olives
lessons.title: He wept over it (Luke 19:41–44)

lessons.spot: Bethany hillside above the Jericho road
lessons.title: I am the resurrection (John 11:17–27)

lessons.spot: Old Roman road climbing from the Jericho desert to Bethany
lessons.title: The house filled with the odor (John 12:1–8)
To the ends of the earth (Acts 1:6–8)

lessons.spot: At-Tur village street on the Mount of Olives summit
lessons.title: Palm Sunday

lessons.spot: Viri Galilaei estate, Mount of Olives
lessons.title: The Ascension

places.name: Capernaum (second visit)
places.why: Peter's town and Jesus' home base, where he spoke of the bread of life.
places.realVisit: Capernaum is on the north shore of the Sea of Galilee, open daily with a small entry fee.

lessons.spot: Church of the Seven Apostles (red domes)
lessons.title: Count the cost (Luke 14:25–33)

lessons.spot: Carved lintels with the manna jar, Capernaum
lessons.title: I am the bread of life (John 6:35)

lessons.spot: Lakeshore path from Capernaum to Tabgha
lessons.title: To whom shall we go (John 6:60–69)

places.name: Jericho oasis (second visit)
places.why: Jericho's palaces, springs and sycamores frame Jesus' parables of money, prayer and Zacchaeus.
places.realVisit: Jericho is 40 minutes from Jerusalem; a cable car climbs to the Mount of Temptation.

places.name: The Cenacle (Upper Room), Mount Zion
places.why: The Upper Room: the Last Supper, the washing of feet, the gift of the Spirit and the first Church.
places.realVisit: The Cenacle is on Mount Zion just outside Zion Gate, open daily; the Dormition Abbey is next door.

lessons.title: Do this for a commemoration of me (Luke 22:14–20)

lessons.spot: Tomb of David hall below the Cenacle
lessons.title: As one that serveth (Luke 22:24–27)

lessons.spot: Lower hall beneath the Upper Room
lessons.title: The towel, slowly (John 13:1–17)

lessons.spot: Sleeping Mary statue, Hagia Maria Sion crypt
lessons.title: Many mansions (John 14:1–6)

lessons.spot: Armenian Church of St Saviour, Mount Zion
lessons.title: My peace I give (John 14:27)

lessons.spot: Stairway to the Holy Spirit chapel
lessons.title: Receive ye the Holy Ghost (John 20:19–23)

lessons.spot: Apse and zodiac floor of Hagia Maria Sion

lessons.spot: Ararat Street gateway by the Syriac Convent

lessons.spot: Hinnom Valley path below Mount Zion
lessons.title: The Dormition

places.name: Garden of Gethsemane, Mount of Olives (second visit)
places.why: Jesus prayed in agony and was arrested in Gethsemane; Mary's tomb lies close by.
places.realVisit: Gethsemane is at the bottom of the Mount of Olives, across the Kidron from the Lions' Gate.

lessons.spot: Church of All Nations façade at night
lessons.title: Drops of blood (Luke 22:39–46)

lessons.spot: Kidron Valley floor below the Golden Gate
lessons.title: The servant's ear (Luke 22:47–53)

lessons.spot: Ancient olive trees of the garden
lessons.title: I am he (John 18:1–11)

places.name: Via Dolorosa (second visit)
places.why: From Herod's palace to the Antonia fortress, the trial and the way of the cross.
places.realVisit: Walk the Via Dolorosa from the Lions' Gate; Franciscans lead the stations every Friday afternoon.

lessons.spot: Ecce Homo Basilica altar under the Roman arch
lessons.title: Behold the man (John 19:1–5)

places.name: Church of the Holy Sepulchre
places.why: Calvary and the empty tomb: the cross, the burial and the resurrection.
places.realVisit: The church is in the Christian Quarter of Jerusalem's Old City, open from early morning daily.

lessons.spot: Altar of the Nailing to the Cross (Latin Calvary)
lessons.title: Father, forgive them (Luke 23:34)

lessons.spot: Greek Orthodox Altar of the Crucifixion
lessons.title: The centurion glorifies God (Luke 23:44–49)

lessons.spot: Armenian Chapel of the Three Marys
lessons.title: Woman, behold thy son (John 19:25–27)

lessons.spot: Tomb of Joseph of Arimathea (Syriac chapel)
lessons.title: Holy Saturday

lessons.spot: Rotunda before the Edicule at Easter dawn
lessons.title: Easter Sunday

lessons.spot: Chapel of the Finding of the Cross
lessons.title: The Exaltation of the Cross (14 September)

lessons.spot: Arches of the Virgin, Holy Sepulchre
lessons.title: Behold thy mother

lessons.spot: Christian Quarter Road on Holy Saturday
lessons.title: Pascha

places.name: Emmaus Nicopolis (second visit)
places.why: Emmaus, where two disciples knew him in the breaking of the bread.
places.realVisit: Emmaus Nicopolis and Latrun are 30 minutes west of Jerusalem by the Tel Aviv highway.

lessons.spot: Hilltop above Emmaus Nicopolis at sunset
lessons.title: Year two close: the book is a person

places.name: Ephesus and the House of the Virgin Mary (second visit)
places.why: John's city and Paul's, the letter to the Ephesians and the council that named Mary Mother of God.
places.realVisit: Fly to Izmir; Ephesus, the Basilica of St John in Selçuk and Meryemana are a short drive apart.

lessons.spot: Tomb of St John, Basilica of St John
lessons.title: In the beginning was the Word (John 1:1–5)

lessons.spot: Ayasuluk Fortress above St John's tomb
lessons.title: The Word was made flesh (John 1:9–14)

lessons.spot: Baptistery of the Basilica of St John
lessons.title: One Lord, one faith, one baptism (Ephesians 4:1–6)

lessons.spot: Bülbüldağı hill road up to Meryem Ana
lessons.title: Mary, Mother of God (1 January)

places.name: Kafr Kanna (Cana) (second visit)
places.why: Cana of the first sign, and home of Nathanael under the fig tree.
places.realVisit: Kafr Kanna is on the road from Nazareth to Tiberias, 15 minutes from Nazareth.

lessons.spot: Greek Orthodox Church of St George, Kafr Kanna
lessons.title: The first sign (John 2:1–11)

places.name: Pool of Bethesda and St Anne's
places.why: The pool of healing, the home of Joachim and Anne, Mary's birthplace and Stephen's gate.
places.realVisit: St Anne's and the Pool of Bethesda are just inside the Lions' Gate, open daily except Sunday.

lessons.spot: Greek Orthodox Church of the Nativity of Mary
lessons.title: The Nativity of Mary (8 September)

places.name: Auschwitz I, Oświęcim
places.why: St Maximilian Kolbe gave his life for another prisoner here: greater love.
places.realVisit: Auschwitz-Birkenau Memorial is an hour from Kraków; entry by timed ticket with a guide.

lessons.spot: Starvation cell of St Maximilian Kolbe, Block 11
lessons.title: Greater love (John 15:13)

lessons.spot: Franciscan Centre of St Maximilian, Harmęże
lessons.title: I have called you friends (John 15:15)

places.name: Taizé (second visit)
places.why: A community of brothers in Burgundy where young Christians of every church pray for unity.
places.realVisit: Taizé welcomes visitors weekly; trains go to Mâcon, then a bus to the village.

lessons.spot: Brancion hilltop village and church of Saint-Pierre
lessons.title: The Spirit of truth (John 16:12–15)
That they all may be one (John 17:20–23)

lessons.spot: Taizé bell tower and meeting hill
lessons.title: Week of Prayer for Christian Unity (18–25 January)

places.name: St Peter in Gallicantu, Mount Zion
places.why: Tradition places Caiaphas' house here: Jesus' night in custody, and the apostles' first trials.
places.realVisit: St Peter in Gallicantu is a short walk down from Zion Gate, open daily except Sunday.

lessons.spot: Church terrace over the Kidron Valley
lessons.title: Gamaliel's advice (Acts 5:34–39)

lessons.spot: Courtyard statue group of Peter's denial
lessons.title: The seven (Acts 6:1–7)

places.name: Old Damascus
places.why: Saul met Ananias in Damascus and escaped over its wall: the conversion of Paul.
places.realVisit: When travel is safe, Straight Street, Ananias' chapel and Bab Kisan are walkable in the old city.

lessons.spot: Bab Sharqi, the Roman east gate of Straight Street
lessons.title: Ananias of Damascus (Acts 9:10–19)

lessons.spot: Chapel of St Paul at Bab Kisan
lessons.title: The Conversion of Saint Paul (25 January)

places.name: Antioch (Antakya)
places.why: Believers were first called Christians in Antioch, which sent Paul and Barnabas out.
places.realVisit: Antakya is reached by flight to Hatay; the cave church is on the slope above the city.

places.name: Philippi
places.why: Paul's first European church: Lydia's baptism, the jail at midnight, and the joyful letter.
places.realVisit: Philippi is 15 km from Kavala in northern Greece; Lydia's baptistery is by the stream nearby.

lessons.spot: Lydia's baptistery by the Zygaktis stream
lessons.title: Lydia (Acts 16:11–15)

places.name: Areopagus, Athens
places.why: Paul spoke to the Athenians about the unknown god on Mars Hill.
places.realVisit: The Areopagus is a free climb just below the Acropolis entrance in central Athens.

places.name: Ancient Corinth
places.why: Paul made tents here and wrote the letters on one body, love and the cross.
places.realVisit: Ancient Corinth is 90 minutes from Athens by car or train and bus.

lessons.title: The foolishness of the cross (1 Corinthians 1:18–25)

places.name: Alexandria Troas
places.why: At Troas, Eutychus fell from a window during Paul's long night sermon.
places.realVisit: Alexandria Troas is on the coast south of Çanakkale, reachable by car.

places.name: Miletus
places.why: Paul said farewell to the Ephesian elders at Miletus.
places.realVisit: Miletus is an hour south of Ephesus by car, near Didim.

places.name: Caesarea Maritima
places.why: Paul made his defense before King Agrippa in Caesarea.
places.realVisit: Caesarea National Park is between Tel Aviv and Haifa on the coast.

places.name: St Paul's Bay, Malta
places.why: Paul was shipwrecked off Malta and welcomed with kindness.
places.realVisit: St Paul's Islands can be seen from Mistra or by boat from Bugibba in Malta.

places.name: Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls (second visit)
places.why: Paul's tomb in Rome, where his letters are read beside his chains.
places.realVisit: St Paul Outside the Walls is on Rome's metro B line (Basilica San Paolo); Tre Fontane is a short ride.

lessons.spot: Statue of St Paul in the quadriporticus
lessons.title: Rome, unhindered (Acts 28:30–31)

lessons.spot: Arch of Galla Placidia mosaic, St Paul's
lessons.title: Not ashamed (Romans 1:16)

lessons.spot: Santa Maria del Popolo, where Luther lodged in 1510
lessons.title: Justified by faith (Romans 3:21–28)

lessons.spot: Abbey of Tre Fontane (site of Paul's martyrdom)
lessons.title: I have kept the faith (2 Timothy 4:6–8)

places.name: Archbasilica of St. John Lateran
places.why: The Pope's cathedral and its baptistery, the Holy Stairs and Laetare at Santa Croce.
places.realVisit: St John Lateran is on Rome's metro A line (San Giovanni); the Holy Stairs are across the square.

lessons.spot: Statues of the apostles, Lateran nave
lessons.title: The Spirit prays (Romans 8:26–27)

lessons.spot: Papal cathedra in the Lateran apse
lessons.title: The Dedication of the Lateran (9 November)

lessons.spot: Gothic ciborium over the papal altar, St John Lateran
lessons.title: Lateran IV, 1215

lessons.spot: Triclinium of Leo III mosaic, Piazza San Giovanni
lessons.title: Three degrees (CCC 1554–1571)

lessons.spot: Lateran Palace on Piazza San Giovanni
lessons.title: Celibacy and married priests (CCC 1579–1580)

lessons.spot: Bishop of Rome's cathedra, Lateran apse
lessons.title: The diocese

lessons.spot: Lateran Palace, where the 1929 treaty was signed
lessons.title: The Holy See

places.name: Colosseum, Rome (second visit)
places.why: Rome of the martyrs: the prison of Peter and Paul, the arch of victory and the arena.
places.realVisit: The Colosseum is on Rome's metro B line; the Mamertine Prison and Arch of Titus are in the Forum area.

lessons.spot: Upper tier walkway of the Colosseum
lessons.title: A living sacrifice (Romans 12)

places.name: Chartres Cathedral (second visit)
places.why: Chartres' glass, crypt and labyrinth teach glimpses, death and the journey; its candles keep Candlemas.
places.realVisit: Chartres is an hour by train from Paris Montparnasse; the labyrinth is uncovered on Fridays.

lessons.spot: Well of the Saints-Forts in the crypt
lessons.title: Where is thy sting (1 Corinthians 15:51–57)

places.name: Mother House of the Missionaries of Charity, Kolkata
places.why: Mother Teresa's Kolkata: strength in weakness, the cheerful giver and the dignity of all.
places.realVisit: The Mother House is on AJC Bose Road; visitors are welcome at Mass and at Mother Teresa's tomb.

lessons.spot: Tomb of Mother Teresa, Mother House
lessons.title: A cheerful giver (2 Corinthians 9:6–8)

lessons.spot: Loreto Convent Entally, where Mother Teresa taught
lessons.title: The option for the poor

places.name: Grotto of Massabielle, Lourdes
places.why: Lourdes, where Bernadette saw Mary, the sick are carried and bathed, and burdens are shared.
places.realVisit: Lourdes has a train station and airport; the domain is open daily, with torchlight processions in season.

lessons.spot: Crowned Virgin statue on the Lourdes esplanade
lessons.title: Lourdes and Fatima as pilgrims

lessons.spot: Way of the Cross on the Espélugues hill
lessons.title: Offering it up (Colossians 1:24)

lessons.spot: The Prairie meadow across the Gave
lessons.title: Anxiety

places.name: Thessaloniki
places.why: Paul's letters to the Thessalonians on hope, prayer and kindness went to this city.
places.realVisit: Thessaloniki has an airport; its churches are walkable in the old upper town and centre.

lessons.title: Not as others without hope (1 Thessalonians 4:13–18)

places.name: Santa Maria de Montserrat Abbey
places.why: Ignatius left his sword at Montserrat; the boys' choir, the cave and the peaks teach young faith.
places.realVisit: Montserrat is an hour from Barcelona by train and rack railway or cable car.

lessons.title: Let no man despise thy youth (1 Timothy 4:12)
The substance of things hoped for (Hebrews 11)

places.name: Ars-sur-Formans, shrine of the Curé of Ars (second visit)
places.why: The Curé of Ars heard confessions up to sixteen hours a day: confession, charity and courage.
places.realVisit: Ars-sur-Formans is 35 km north of Lyon; the shrine, presbytery and confessional are open daily.

lessons.spot: Fields of Ars along the Formans
lessons.title: A thousand years as a day (2 Peter 3:8–9)

lessons.spot: Chapel of St. Philomena, Ars basilica
lessons.title: What we have handled (1 John 1:1–4)

lessons.spot: Sacristy where the Curé heard men's confessions
lessons.title: If we confess (1 John 1:8–9)
In deed and in truth (1 John 3:18)
Perfect charity casts out fear (1 John 4:18)

places.name: Patmos
places.why: John received the Apocalypse on Patmos; the letters of love were treasured there.
places.realVisit: Patmos is reached by ferry from Piraeus or nearby islands; walk from Skala to the cave and monastery.

lessons.title: Keep yourselves in the love of God (Jude 20–25)

lessons.spot: Monastery of St John the Theologian
lessons.title: Reading the Apocalypse

places.name: Laodicea and Pamukkale
places.why: Laodicea, warned for being lukewarm, sat between Hierapolis' hot springs and Colossae's cold water.

places.realVisit: Take Milan metro M1 or M3 to Duomo; the rooftop terraces are open to visitors.

lessons.spot: Basilica of San Nazaro in Brolo
lessons.title: Two wills (8.9–8.10)

places.name: Ostia Antica
places.why: At Ostia Augustine and Monica shared their vision at a window, and here she died.
places.realVisit: Take the Roma–Lido train from Rome's Porta San Paolo station to Ostia Antica.

places.name: Basilica of St. Augustine, Annaba (Hippo) (third visit)
places.why: Augustine wrote the Confessions as bishop of Hippo, so the book closes where it was written.
places.realVisit: Fly to Annaba; the basilica and the Hippo Regius site are a short taxi ride from the centre.

lessons.spot: Basilica of Peace ruins, Hippo Regius
lessons.title: Give what you command (10.29)

lessons.spot: Statue of St. Augustine, basilica garden
lessons.title: Confessions close

places.name: Kempen, birthplace of Thomas à Kempis
places.why: The Imitation's author took his name from this small Rhineland town.
places.realVisit: Take a regional train from Düsseldorf or Krefeld to Kempen; the old town is walkable.

places.name: Deventer, home of the Brothers of the Common Life (second visit)
places.why: Thomas à Kempis was formed in Deventer by the Modern Devotion of Geert Groote.
places.realVisit: Take the train to Deventer station and walk ten minutes to the Brink.

places.name: Zwolle and Mount St. Agnes
places.why: Thomas à Kempis lived seventy years at Mount St. Agnes near Zwolle; his relics rest in the city.
places.realVisit: Take the train to Zwolle; Agnietenberg is a short bike ride east along the Vecht.

places.why: The Windesheim reform drew on the forest mystics of Groenendaal; the Imitation's inner books are read among their trees.
places.realVisit: Take the train to Groenendaal station in Hoeilaart; the priory site and forest paths start there.

places.name: Via Dolorosa (fifth visit)
places.why: The Imitation's "royal way of the cross" is read on the street of the cross itself.
places.realVisit: Walk the Stations of the Cross from the Lions' Gate in Jerusalem's Old City; Franciscans lead it on Fridays.

places.name: Annecy, city of St. Francis de Sales (second visit)
places.why: Francis de Sales was bishop here and wrote the Introduction to the Devout Life for ordinary people.
places.realVisit: Take the train to Annecy; the old town, lake and Visitation basilica are walkable.

places.realVisit: Drive or take a bus about 20 km northeast of Annecy to Thorens-Glières; the château is open in summer.

places.name: Thonon-les-Bains, the Chablais mission
places.why: Francis de Sales won back the Chablais by patient preaching and leaflets pushed under doors.
places.realVisit: Take the train to Thonon-les-Bains; the basilica and lake promenade are in the centre.

places.name: Château des Allinges
places.why: From the fort of Allinges Francis de Sales walked out each day to his mission; virtues are learned on the way.
places.realVisit: Drive about 7 km south of Thonon to Allinges and walk up to the castle chapel.

places.name: Fourvière and Vieux Lyon
places.why: Francis de Sales died in Lyon, and his counsels on gentleness and friendship are read in its old streets.
places.realVisit: Take the funicular from Vieux Lyon station up to Fourvière.

lessons.title: Poor in spirit, even if rich (III.14–III.16)

places.name: Alençon, birthplace of St. Thérèse
places.why: Thérèse was born and baptized in Alençon, where the Story of a Soul begins.

places.realVisit: Take the train from Paris to Lisieux; the Carmel chapel and Les Buissonnets are open to pilgrims.

places.name: Ancient Smyrna (İzmir) (second visit)

places.name: Canterbury Cathedral (second visit)

places.realVisit: Take the train from London Marylebone to Beaconsfield.

lessons.spot: Church of St. Teresa of the Child Jesus

places.name: Basilica of Santa Maria Maggiore (fifth visit)

places.name: Myeongdong Cathedral, Seoul

places.realVisit: Take the train to Paray-le-Monial in Burgundy; the shrines are in the town centre.
