places.why: Tradition holds that Krishna spoke the Bhagavad Gita to Arjuna here, under a banyan descended from the one that heard it.
places.realVisit: Open daily; the evening light show runs most nights; winter is pleasant, summer very hot.

lessons.title: the thing that's yours to do
the ocean the wave forgets it is

places.name: Sri Krishna Museum, Kurukshetra
places.why: Kurukshetra's museum of Krishna and the Gita, where the vision of the universal form is shown in art across the ages.
places.realVisit: Open Tuesday to Sunday; near Brahma Sarovar; allow two hours.

places.name: Sandipani Ashram, Ujjain
places.why: Krishna and Sudama studied here with their guru; the place still honors the bond of teacher and student.
places.realVisit: Open daily; Ujjain is easiest October to March; combine with the Mahakal temple.

lessons.title: anyone who turns a light on

places.name: Hanuman Garhi, Ayodhya
places.why: Hanuman is said to guard Ayodhya from this hilltop; it is where devotees start every visit to Rama's city.
places.realVisit: Open daily; seventy-six steps up; mornings are best, Tuesdays and Saturdays are busiest.

lessons.title: Fourteen years to walk on water

places.name: Sringeri Sharada Peetham
places.why: The first monastery Adi Shankara founded, on the Tunga river, still teaching his non-dual vision.
places.realVisit: Open daily; monsoon June to September is lush but wet; free meals are served at the math.

lessons.title: Who may say I am Brahman?

places.name: Patal Bhuvaneshwar Cave
places.why: A Himalayan limestone cave whose rock forms are worshipped as Ganesha's severed head and the story of his birth.
places.realVisit: Open daily in daylight; a narrow crawl down by chain, guided; April to June and autumn are best.

places.name: Dagdusheth Halwai Ganapati, Pune
places.why: Pune's famous Ganesha temple, a living home of his stories, sweets and festival.
places.realVisit: Open daily nearly round the clock; Ganesh Chaturthi in August-September is spectacular and packed.

places.name: Anjanadri Hill, Hampi
places.why: In Karnataka tradition Hanuman was born on this hill in Kishkindha, where he first met Rama.
places.realVisit: Open daily; 575 steps to the top; go at sunrise, October to February.

places.name: Sita Amman Temple, Nuwara Eliya
places.why: Sri Lankan tradition places Ashok Vatika, where Sita was held, at this stream in the hill country.
places.realVisit: Open daily; on the Nuwara Eliya to Badulla road; cool and misty all year.

lessons.spot: Sita Amman blade of grass rock
lessons.title: As light belongs to the sun

places.name: Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir, Ayodhya
places.why: The temple at the place devotees revere as Rama's birthplace.
places.realVisit: Open daily with security checks; no phones allowed inside; mornings are calmer.

places.name: Janaki Mandir, Janakpur
places.why: Janakpur was King Janaka's Mithila, Sita's home and the court of the great Upanishad sages.
places.realVisit: Open daily; reachable by road or rail from Bihar; Vivah Panchami in Nov-Dec reenacts the wedding.

lessons.title: The birds who fed a guest
The butcher who taught a monk
Janaka, the king who was free

places.name: Ganga Sagar, Janakpur
places.why: One of Janakpur's great sacred ponds, where the questions of Mithila's sages are remembered.
places.realVisit: Open all year; evening arti on the banks.

places.name: Ram ki Paidi, Ayodhya
places.why: The long ghats of the Saryu, where Rama left for exile and where the whole city lights lamps for his return.
places.realVisit: Open all year; Deepotsav on Diwali eve lights millions of lamps; winter evenings are lovely.

places.name: Ramghat, Chitrakoot
places.why: Rama, Sita and Lakshmana lived in Chitrakoot's forests, and Bharata came here to bring Rama home.
places.realVisit: Open all year; boat rides on the Mandakini; Kamadgiri parikrama is a 5 km walk.

places.name: Panchavati, Nashik
places.why: Rama, Sita and Lakshmana settled here by the Godavari; the golden deer and the abduction unfolded nearby.
places.realVisit: Open all year; Kalaram temple and Sita Gufa are within walking distance; winter is pleasant.

places.name: Lepakshi, Andhra Pradesh
places.why: Tradition says the vulture Jatayu fell here fighting Ravana, and Rama told him to rise: le pakshi.
places.realVisit: Open daily; an easy day trip from Bengaluru; the Veerabhadra temple has a famous hanging pillar.

lessons.title: Sita calls the forest to witness

places.name: Pampa Sarovar, Hampi
places.why: The lake of Kishkindha where Shabari waited for Rama and the monkey kingdom joined his search.
places.realVisit: Open daily; near Anegundi across the river from Hampi; October to February.

places.name: Dhanushkodi, Rameswaram
places.why: At this tip of India, the story says Rama's army built the bridge to Lanka and Vibhishana came over to Rama.
places.realVisit: Open in daylight only; road to Arichal Munai point; October to March, avoid cyclone season.

places.name: Rumassala, Galle
places.why: Sri Lankan tradition says this hill is a piece of the herb mountain Hanuman carried for Lakshmana.
places.realVisit: Open all year; a short drive from Galle Fort; walk to Jungle Beach.

places.name: Ravana Ella Falls
places.why: The hills of Ella are woven through with Sri Lankan Ravana stories: caves, falls and his last stand.
places.realVisit: Open all year; by the Ella-Wellawaya road; the Ravana cave is a short climb nearby.

places.name: Divurumpola Temple
places.why: Sri Lankan tradition says Sita's trial by fire took place here; it is still a place of oaths.
places.realVisit: Open daily; near Welimada on the Nuwara Eliya road; quiet all year.

places.name: Hastinapur
places.why: The capital of the Kuru kingdom, where the Pandava and Kaurava cousins grew up and the dice game began.
places.realVisit: Open all year; near Meerut; Pandeshwar temple and the excavated mound are nearby.

lessons.title: The maid who welcomed the sage

places.name: Vidur ka Tila, Hastinapur
places.why: The excavated mound of old Hastinapur, named for Vidura, where the Kuru city's stories rise from the earth.
places.realVisit: Open by day; an Archaeological Survey site in Hastinapur.

lessons.title: The ghost and the curly tail

places.name: Brahma Sarovar, Kurukshetra
places.why: The great tank at Kurukshetra where the two armies camped before the war; the Gita is recited here every year.
places.realVisit: Open all year; the International Gita Mahotsav in Nov-Dec fills it with lamps.

lessons.title: The self no weapon can cut
The right to act, never to the fruit
From desire to anger, and the ocean's peace

places.name: Sthaneshwar Mahadev Temple, Thanesar
places.why: Thanesar's ancient Shiva temple and tank, where the Pandavas are said to have prayed before the war.
places.realVisit: Open daily; in Kurukshetra's old town; quiet mornings.

lessons.title: The ghost and the curly tail

places.name: Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi, Mathura
places.why: The temple complex at the prison cell where devotees say Krishna was born at midnight.
places.realVisit: Open daily with strict security; Janmashtami in August is huge; no phones in the cell shrine.

lessons.title: Janmashtami: the night Krishna was born
Ganesh Chaturthi: the moon that laughed

places.name: Ambaji Temple, Gujarat
places.why: One of the great Shakti seats, where Gujarat's Navaratri garba is offered to the Goddess.
places.realVisit: Open daily; Navaratri in Sept-Oct is the high season; Gabbar hill ropeway nearby.

lessons.title: Navaratri: nine nights of the Goddess
Kanya puja: girls as the Goddess

places.name: Radha Rani Temple, Barsana
places.why: Radha's village in Braj, where Holi is played for days and the festivals of Krishna's land come alive.
places.realVisit: Open daily; Lathmar Holi in February-March is famous and very crowded.

lessons.title: Maha Shivaratri: the great night of Shiva
Raksha Bandhan: the thread of protection
Holika Dahan: the boy in the fire

places.name: Nand Bhavan, Gokul
places.why: Krishna's childhood village by the Yamuna, the land of butter, cowherds and his mother Yashoda.
places.realVisit: Open daily; an hour from Mathura; mornings are calmest.

lessons.title: Janmashtami: the universe in a baby's mouth

places.name: Brahmand Ghat, Mahavan
places.why: The Yamuna ghat where Yashoda is said to have seen the universe in Krishna's mouth.
places.realVisit: Open all year; near Gokul.

places.name: Kalighat Kali Temple, Kolkata
places.why: Kolkata's ancient Kali temple, heart of Bengal's Durga and Kali festivals.
places.realVisit: Open daily; crowded on Tuesdays and Saturdays; Kali Puja falls on Diwali night.

places.name: Banke Bihari Temple, Vrindavan
places.why: Vrindavan's most beloved Krishna temple, where the curtain is drawn every few minutes so no one stares too long.
places.realVisit: Open daily in two sessions; very crowded on weekends and festivals; mind your phone and glasses with the monkeys.

places.name: Vindhyavasini Devi, Vindhyachal
places.why: The Goddess who left Kamsa's cell is said to dwell here on the Ganga as Vindhyavasini.
places.realVisit: Open daily; near Mirzapur; Navaratri crowds are enormous.

lessons.title: Janmashtami: the girl in the cell
Janmashtami: the night Krishna was born

places.name: Naimisharanya
places.why: The forest where the sages gathered to hear the Puranas, still a place of honest questions.
places.realVisit: Open all year; near Sitapur in Uttar Pradesh; Chakra Tirtha is the center.

places.name: Kaivalyadhama, Lonavala
places.why: A century-old yoga institute where breath practice has been taught and studied since 1924.
places.realVisit: Open to visitors and course students; monsoon June-September is beautiful.

places.name: Srisailam Mallikarjuna and Bhramaramba
places.why: A jyotirlinga and Shakti seat in the Nallamala forest, where the Goddess is Bhramaramba, mother of bees.
places.realVisit: Open daily; forest road closes at night; Shivaratri is the main festival.

places.name: ISKCON Mayapur
places.why: Chaitanya's birthplace in Bengal, now the world headquarters of chanting Hare Krishna.
places.realVisit: Open daily; Gaura Purnima in Feb-March is the big festival; guesthouses on site.

places.name: Valmiki Ashram, Bithoor
places.why: Bithoor on the Ganga is revered as Valmiki's hermitage, where the Ramayana was first sung.
places.realVisit: Open all year; near Kanpur; quiet weekday mornings.

places.name: Shrinathji Temple, Nathdwara
places.why: Shrinathji is worshipped like a beloved child here, with offerings changing through the day.
places.realVisit: Open for set darshan times through the day; check timings; Annakut after Diwali.

places.name: Gangotri Temple
places.why: The Ganga's high source temple, where Bhagiratha is said to have prayed for the river to come down.
places.realVisit: Open roughly May to November; a long mountain drive from Rishikesh; acclimatize to altitude.

lessons.title: The paste meant for a king

places.name: Sudama Mandir, Porbandar
places.why: Porbandar honors Sudama, Krishna's poor childhood friend whose handful of rice is the heart of devotion.
places.realVisit: Open daily; Porbandar is also Gandhi's birthplace; winter is best.

places.name: Konark Sun Temple
places.why: A colossal stone chariot of the Sun god, made for a sunrise practice that needs no objects.
places.realVisit: Open sunrise to sunset; the Konark Dance Festival is in December; near Puri.

places.name: Vitthal Temple, Pandharpur
places.why: Pandharpur's Vitthal draws the great Ekadashi walking pilgrimage and the songs of the Marathi saints.
places.realVisit: Open daily; Ashadhi Ekadashi in June-July brings the wari walk and huge crowds.

lessons.title: Savata the gardener: work as worship

places.name: Udupi Sri Krishna Matha
places.why: Udupi's Krishna faces the window where the poet Kanakadasa sang, and Madhva's philosophy is taught.
places.realVisit: Open daily; free meals are served; Paryaya festival every two years in January.

places.name: Anantheshwara Temple, Udupi
places.why: Udupi's oldest temple, where Madhva is said to have taught and vanished at the end of his life.
places.realVisit: Open daily; beside the Krishna Matha.

lessons.title: The Krishna in the ballast clay
The gopis and the learned messenger

places.name: Dehu, Tukaram's village
places.why: The village where Tukaram sang; tradition says his notebooks thrown into the Indrayani came back dry.
places.realVisit: Open all year; near Pune; the wari walk to Pandharpur starts here in June.

places.name: Govardhan Hill
places.why: The hill Krishna is said to have lifted to shelter Braj; it is circled and offered mountains of food after Diwali.
places.realVisit: Open all year; the 21 km parikrama is walked barefoot; Annakut after Diwali is the big day.

lessons.title: Why the village fed a hill

places.name: Lalbaug and Girgaon Chowpatty, Mumbai
places.why: Mumbai's Ganesh festival comes to the street at Lalbaug and goes back to the sea at Chowpatty.
places.realVisit: Ganesh Chaturthi in August-September; the immersion procession is vast; go early.

places.name: Neelkanth Mahadev Temple
places.why: The forest temple where Shiva is said to have held the ocean's poison in his throat.
places.realVisit: Open daily; a mountain road or a trek from Rishikesh; Shravan month is crowded.

lessons.title: The god with the blue throat
The sign of the endless light

places.name: Gangasagar
places.why: Where the Ganga meets the sea; the Makar Sankranti bath here is one of India's largest gatherings.
places.realVisit: Reached by ferry; the Makar Sankranti mela in mid-January draws millions.

places.name: Thrikkakara Vamana Temple
places.why: Kerala's Onam centers on this temple of Vamana, who asked King Mahabali for three steps of land.
places.realVisit: Open daily; Onam in August-September is the festival; near Kochi.

places.name: Somnath Temple
places.why: The first jyotirlinga on the Arabian Sea, linked to the moon god's healing.
places.realVisit: Open daily; the evening light show tells its history; winter is best.

lessons.title: Why Hindus bathe the Shiva linga

places.name: Sannihit Sarovar, Kurukshetra
places.why: A sacred tank of Kurukshetra where the Gita's teaching on action is honored.
places.realVisit: Open all year; busy during solar eclipses; near Brahma Sarovar.

lessons.title: Three kinds of seeing and doing

places.name: Dwarkadhish Temple, Dwarka
places.why: Krishna's royal city on the western sea, where he reigns as king of Dwarka.
places.realVisit: Open daily; flag changed five times a day; Janmashtami is huge; Bet Dwarka by boat.

places.name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Varanasi
places.why: Shiva's golden temple at the heart of Kashi, where Shankara met the stranger in the lane.
places.realVisit: Open daily from 3 am; long queues; no phones inside; winter mornings are best.

places.name: Bihar School of Yoga, Munger
places.why: A world-known yoga school on the Ganga, teaching the Gita's meditation in daily practice.
places.realVisit: Courses by application; visitors at set times; winter is best.

lessons.title: Lift the self by the self
A clean place, a firm seat
The lamp in a windless place
The breath gets up to leave

places.name: Guruvayur Krishna Temple
places.why: Kerala's great Krishna temple, where devotees of every kind come in trouble, curiosity, need and knowing.
places.realVisit: Open daily; strict dress code (dhoti, saree); temple elephants at Punnathur Kotta.

places.name: Bhishma Kund, Narkatari
places.why: Where Bhishma is said to have lain on his bed of arrows, waiting for the sun to turn north.
places.realVisit: Open all year; a short drive from Kurukshetra town.

places.name: Krishna Balaram Mandir, Vrindavan
places.why: ISKCON's Vrindavan temple, where Krishna's secret of devotion is sung all day.
places.realVisit: Open daily; kirtan all day; Kartik month in Oct-Nov is lovely.

lessons.title: The robber who became a poet

places.name: Brahma Temple, Pushkar
places.why: One of the very few temples to Brahma, the creator, by Pushkar's sacred lake.
places.realVisit: Open daily; the Kartik camel fair in Nov draws crowds; quiet in summer.

lessons.title: In which forms should I think of you?

places.name: Belur Math
places.why: The headquarters Vivekananda founded for the Ramakrishna Order, honoring God with and without form.
places.realVisit: Open daily except midday closure; evening arti is beautiful; no photos inside.

lessons.title: Neti, neti: not this, not this
Full from full: the peace chant

places.name: Dashashwamedh Ghat, Varanasi
places.why: Varanasi's main ghat, where the Ganga arti fills the night and teachers have met seekers for millennia.
places.realVisit: Open all year; evening Ganga arti nightly; take a sunrise boat.

lessons.title: The same Lord in all beings

places.name: Dakshineswar Kali Temple
places.why: Ramakrishna lived and taught here; his parables still teach the three gunas.
places.realVisit: Open daily; across the river from Belur by boat; mornings are calmest.

lessons.title: The sage who knew only the words

places.name: Jagannath Temple, Puri
places.why: Puri is Purushottama Kshetra, home of Jagannath and the Gita Govinda sung daily for him.
places.realVisit: Non-Hindus may not enter; view from nearby rooftops; Rath Yatra in June-July.

places.name: Swargadwar, Puri
places.why: Puri's seaside cremation ground and beach, a place of last meals and last songs.
places.realVisit: Open all year.

places.name: Gita Press, Gorakhpur
places.why: The publisher that has printed hundreds of millions of Gitas, teaching scripture as a steering wheel.
places.realVisit: Open to visitors on working days; the Leela Chitra Mandir gallery shows the Gita in paintings.

lessons.title: Arjuna asks, why act at all?
Taught to the sun, told again

places.name: ISKCON Bangalore and Akshaya Patra
places.why: A hilltop temple whose kitchens feed over a million schoolchildren daily: faith and food as one offering.
places.realVisit: Open daily; the Akshaya Patra kitchen offers tours by booking.

lessons.title: Om tat sat: the threefold name
As hard to hold as the wind

places.name: Bhaktivedanta Manor, Watford
places.why: A Hindu temple in an English manor, where the Gita's final chapter is lived by a community far from Kurukshetra.
places.realVisit: Open daily; Janmashtami draws huge crowds; near London.

places.name: Sabarmati Ashram, Ahmedabad
places.why: Gandhi lived here and read the Gita as a guide to nonviolent action.
places.realVisit: Open daily; free; quiet early morning; prayer ground by the river.

places.name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Uttarkashi
places.why: The Himalayan "Kashi" on the Bhagirathi, an old seat of monks studying the Upanishads.
places.realVisit: Open all year; base for Gangotri; spring and autumn are best.

lessons.title: Fire and the blade of grass

places.name: Eknath's Paithan
places.why: Paithan on the Godavari is Eknath's town; he poured Ganga water carried for Shiva into a dying donkey's mouth.
places.realVisit: Open all year; near Aurangabad; Nath Shashthi fair in March.

lessons.title: The face of truth, covered in gold

places.name: Arsha Vidya Gurukulam, Anaikatti
places.why: A traditional school of the Upanishads founded by Swami Dayananda in the Nilgiri foothills.
places.realVisit: Courses by application; visitors welcome at set times; near Coimbatore.

lessons.title: The eye does not go there

places.name: Gauri Kund, Kedar valley
places.why: Parvati is said to have done her tapas here to win Shiva; it is the trailhead to Kedarnath.
places.realVisit: Open roughly May to November; start of the Kedarnath trek; monsoon brings landslides.

lessons.title: Fire and the blade of grass

places.name: Nachiketa Tal
places.why: A forest lake in the Garhwal hills named for Nachiketa, the boy who questioned Death.
places.realVisit: A short trek from Chaurangi Khal near Uttarkashi; spring and autumn.

places.name: Vivekananda Rock Memorial, Kanyakumari
places.why: Vivekananda meditated on this rock at India's southern tip before rousing the world with "arise, awake".
places.realVisit: Ferries run daytime; sunrise from the shore is famous; year-round.

places.name: Omkareshwar
places.why: A jyotirlinga on an om-shaped island in the Narmada, the natural home of lessons on om.
places.realVisit: Open daily; boat or bridge to the island; monsoon swells the river.

lessons.title: The god, the demon and the pan of water
Indra walks back: the dreamer isn't the self
Deep sleep, and the one who sees

places.name: Sri Ramanasramam, Tiruvannamalai
places.why: Ramana Maharshi taught here at the foot of Arunachala through silence and the question "who am I?".
places.realVisit: Open daily; free; Kartikai Deepam in Nov-Dec lights the hill; walk the 14 km girivalam.

lessons.title: The student who asked about om
The teacher who answered with silence
To whom did this thought come?

places.name: Ramana Maharshi Mandiram, Madurai
places.why: The house where sixteen-year-old Ramana lay down, acted out his own death, and woke to the self.
places.realVisit: Open daily; a short walk from the Meenakshi temple; free.

lessons.title: The boy who asked what dies
Ramana at sixteen: who am I?

places.name: Kedar Ghat, Varanasi
places.why: A south-Indian-style ghat of Kashi, a calm place for the knowing path.
places.realVisit: Open all year; quieter than Dashashwamedh; sunrise boat rides.

lessons.title: The man on the lane in Kashi
The boy bent in eight places
The tiger who thought he was a goat

places.name: Kalady, Shankara's birthplace
places.why: Adi Shankara was born here on the Periyar, where a crocodile is said to have released him to take sannyasa.
places.realVisit: Open all year; near Kochi airport; the Adi Shankara Keerthi Stambha tower is nearby.

places.name: Jyotirmath
places.why: One of Shankara's four monasteries, high in the Himalaya, where he wrote and taught.
places.realVisit: Open all year; on the road to Badrinath; check road status in monsoon.

lessons.title: Fear not, there is a way
Who are you? Shankara at the cave
Bhrigu and the riddle of Brahman

places.name: Sri Ranganathaswamy Temple, Srirangam
places.why: Ramanuja's temple-island, home of surrender as the path, between two arms of the Kaveri.
places.realVisit: Open daily; the rooftop view is worth it; Vaikuntha Ekadashi in Dec-Jan.

lessons.title: You are that, or you are his?
The king who asked to be a step
Carried in on a priest's shoulders

places.name: Thillai Nataraja Temple, Chidambaram
places.why: Patanjali, author of the Yoga Sutras, is honored here beside the dancing Shiva.
places.realVisit: Open daily; the Natyanjali dance festival is in February-March.

lessons.title: Indra asks what the self is

places.name: Madhuvan, Mathura
places.why: The forest where the boy Dhruva did his tapas until Vishnu appeared.
places.realVisit: Open all year; part of the Braj parikrama route.

lessons.title: Dhruva, the star that never moves
Krishna and the handful of rice
Dhruva, the boy who became the pole star

places.name: Seva Kunj, Vrindavan
places.why: The grove where tradition says Krishna danced the rasa with the gopis.
places.realVisit: Open by day; closed after dusk by tradition; Sharad Purnima is special.

places.name: Mattancherry, Kochi
places.why: In Kochi a Jain temple, synagogue, churches, mosques and Hindu temples stand within walking distance: good company for meeting other faiths.
places.realVisit: Open all year; the synagogue closes Fridays and Saturdays; October to March.

lessons.title: The emperor on the langar floor
The Buddha lets the breath be

places.name: BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Neasden
places.why: A great carved temple in London, where Hindus far from India wear their faith at work and on the train.
places.realVisit: Open daily; free; modest dress; Diwali and Annakut are spectacular.

places.name: Mahabaleshwar Temple, Gokarna
places.why: Where Ravana is said to have set down Shiva's atmalinga; Ravana's devotion to Shiva lives in its lore.
places.realVisit: Open daily; beaches nearby; October to March.

lessons.title: The breath the demons couldn't pierce

places.name: Meera Temple, Chittorgarh Fort
places.why: Mirabai lived and sang for Krishna in this fort; her temple still stands within it.
places.realVisit: Open daily; the fort is huge, hire a guide; winter is best.

lessons.title: Mother, I didn't eat the butter

places.name: Andal Temple, Srivilliputhur
places.why: Andal, the poet-saint who wore God's garland first, lived here; its tower is Tamil Nadu's emblem.
places.realVisit: Open daily; famous for its sweet palkova; Margazhi month in Dec-Jan.

lessons.title: A leaf, a flower, a little water

places.name: Srikalahasti Temple
places.why: Here the hunter Kannappa offered Shiva his own eye; the temple remembers him.
places.realVisit: Open daily; famous for Rahu-Ketu puja; near Tirupati.

lessons.title: Parvati's question: tantra for a hard age

places.name: Kanchi Kamakoti Peetham, Kanchipuram
places.why: Kanchipuram's math and Vedic schools keep the old chanting of the Upanishads alive.
places.realVisit: Open daily; Kanchipuram is a day trip from Chennai; famous for silk saris.

lessons.title: The dogs who chanted for breakfast

places.name: Varadaraja Perumal Temple, Kanchipuram
places.why: Kanchipuram's great Vishnu temple, where the old chants are sung.
places.realVisit: Open daily.

lessons.title: The horse the size of the sky
Asato ma: the breath the demons couldn't pierce

places.name: Lalita Devi Temple, Naimisharanya
places.why: The Goddess temple at the heart of the sages' forest.
places.realVisit: Open daily.

places.name: Parmarth Niketan, Rishikesh
places.why: A large Rishikesh ashram on the Ganga, where father-and-son teachings of the Upanishads are given daily.
places.realVisit: Open all year; evening Ganga arti at the ghat; the yoga festival is in March.

lessons.spot: Parmarth Shiva statue in the river
lessons.title: In the beginning, Being
The mind is made of food

places.name: Sivananda Ashram, Rishikesh
places.why: The Divine Life Society's home, where Swami Sivananda taught that the self is found in the everyday.
places.realVisit: Open daily; free; quiet early morning satsang.

lessons.title: The tree that bleeds and lives

places.name: Kailash Ashram, Muni ki Reti
places.why: One of Rishikesh's oldest Vedanta schools, where monks have studied the Upanishads since 1880.
places.realVisit: Open to visitors by day; classes for resident students.

places.name: Chinmaya Tapovan, Sidhbari
places.why: A Himalayan ashram below the Dhauladhar snows, devoted to the Upanishads' ladder inward.
places.realVisit: Open all year; near Dharamshala; spring and autumn are clearest.

lessons.title: Even the mind stands on food
The city of Brahman in the heart

places.name: Chamunda Devi Temple, Kangra
places.why: A Goddess temple on the Baner river below the Dhauladhar.
places.realVisit: Open daily; near Dharamshala.

places.name: Ardhanareeswarar Temple, Tiruchengode
places.why: A hilltop temple to Shiva as half-man, half-woman: the self that fell in two.
places.realVisit: Open daily; reached by road or a long stair; cooler in winter.

lessons.title: I am: the self's first words
My other half: the self that fell in two

places.name: Vidyashankara Temple, Sringeri
places.why: Sringeri's carved stone temple to the teacher Vidyashankara, where the Upanishads' teachers are honored.
places.realVisit: Open daily; within the Sringeri math complex.

places.name: Ram Mandir, Janakpur
places.why: Janakpur's old Rama temple, a short walk from Janaki Mandir, where King Janaka's court debates are retold.
places.realVisit: Open all year; Ram Navami fair in spring.

lessons.spot: Janakpur Ram Sita Vivah Mandir garden
lessons.title: A thousand cows for the wisest
Take my hand: the whispered word was karma

places.name: Punaura Dham, Sitamarhi
places.why: Mithila tradition says Sita was found in a furrow here; the region kept the debates of Janaka's court alive.
places.realVisit: Open all year; near Sitamarhi town; Sita Navami in spring.

lessons.title: Kahola: beyond hunger, grief and death
Gargi: on what is everything woven?

places.name: Sri Aurobindo Ashram, Puducherry
places.why: Sri Aurobindo and the Mother taught the lights of waking, dreaming and deep sleep here by the sea.
places.realVisit: Open daily; silent samadhi courtyard; avoid peak afternoon heat.

places.name: Gurukul Kangri, Haridwar
places.why: A century-old Vedic school on the Ganga where students still hear the Taittiriya's graduation words.
places.realVisit: Campus open to visitors by day; Haridwar is easiest October to March.

places.name: Bhrigu Mandir, Ballia
places.why: Ballia honors the sage Bhrigu, whose son Varuna sent him back five times to find Brahman.
places.realVisit: Open all year; the Dadri cattle fair in November is famous.

lessons.title: The song of the one who knows

places.name: Elephanta Caves
places.why: The great Shiva caves in Mumbai harbor, carved to show the one self taking many forms.
places.realVisit: Ferries from the Gateway of India; closed Mondays; monsoon seas can be rough.

lessons.title: The self alone, before the worlds
The gods choose a human home
Hunger and thirst get a share
The self comes in at the crown
Three births: the third is death

places.name: Perur Patteeswarar Temple
places.why: An ancient Shiva temple near Coimbatore, where seekers have long asked their questions.
places.realVisit: Open daily; near Coimbatore.

lessons.title: Six students wait a year to ask
Matter, breath and the two paths

places.name: Jwalamukhi Temple
places.why: A Himalayan Goddess temple where natural flames burn from the rock: sparks from one fire.
places.realVisit: Open daily; in Kangra district; Navaratri is busy.

places.name: Chandrabhaga Beach, Konark
places.why: The beach by the Sun Temple, where the Magha Saptami sunrise bath is held.
places.realVisit: Open all year; Magha Saptami in Jan-Feb.

places.name: Pashupatinath Temple, Kathmandu
places.why: Nepal's great Shiva temple on the Bagmati, where Rudra is worshipped as lord of all beings.
places.realVisit: Inner temple for Hindus only; ghats and hillside open to all; Shivaratri brings huge crowds.

lessons.title: Smaller than small, greater than great (3.20)

places.name: Ekvira Devi Temple, Karla
places.why: A hill shrine of the Goddess above the Karla caves near Lonavala.
places.realVisit: Open daily; steep steps; Navaratri is busy.

lessons.title: Salt in the water: you are that
King Lavana's dream and the seer
The golden deer and the five turnings

places.name: Jaganmohan Palace, Mysore
places.why: In this palace Krishnamacharya taught the yoga that spread around the world.
places.realVisit: Open daily as an art gallery; Mysore Dasara in Sept-Oct is grand.

lessons.title: Bhagiratha and the rest of us

places.name: Girnar Hill, Junagadh
places.why: Dattatreya, the wandering sage with twenty-four teachers, is honored on Girnar's summit after nearly ten thousand steps.
places.realVisit: About 10,000 steps or the ropeway; start before dawn; the Lili Parikrama is in November.

lessons.title: The arrow-maker who didn't look up

places.name: Shukratal
places.why: Where Shuka is said to have told King Parikshit the Bhagavata over his last seven days, beneath an ancient banyan.
places.realVisit: Open all year; near Muzaffarnagar; Bhagavata recitations run often.

places.name: Thillai Kali Amman Temple, Chidambaram
places.why: Chidambaram's Kali temple, linked to the dance contest of Shiva and the Goddess.
places.realVisit: Open daily.

lessons.title: The serpent who came to teach

places.name: Sri Padmanabhaswamy Temple, Thiruvananthapuram
places.why: Vishnu reclines here on the serpent Shesha, who holds the world without strain.
places.realVisit: Hindus only inside, strict dress code; the tank and tower are visible to all.

lessons.title: The serpent who holds the world

places.name: Drona Sagar, Kashipur
places.why: A tank said to be where Drona trained the Pandavas: the place of the bird's eye and Ekalavya's devotion.
places.realVisit: Open all year; in Kashipur, Uttarakhand; quiet weekday mornings.

lessons.title: The king and the palanquin bearer
Vyasa sees the hard days coming

places.name: Ahilya Ghat, Maheshwar
places.why: Ancient Mahishmati on the Narmada, where tradition places Shankara's great debate with Mandana Mishra.
places.realVisit: Open all year; boats to the river island; famous handloom saris.

places.name: Brihadeeswarar Temple, Thanjavur
places.why: The great Chola temple with its giant Nandi, Shiva's own devotee at the door.
places.realVisit: Open daily; a UNESCO site; evenings light the tower gold.

places.name: Vishram Ghat, Mathura
places.why: Krishna is said to have rested here after defeating Kamsa; Mathura's main ghat on the Yamuna.
places.realVisit: Open all year; evening Yamuna arti nightly; boats at dawn.

places.name: Ahobilam
places.why: Ahobilam's forest of nine Narasimha shrines is where the man-lion is said to have burst from the pillar for Prahlada.
places.realVisit: Open daily; rough forest treks to the upper shrines; go in winter.

lessons.title: The boy who asked for nothing
Bali Pratipada: the demon king welcomed home
Holi: the Lord in the pillar
Maha Shivaratri: the great night of Shiva

places.name: Brahmavart Ghat, Bithoor
places.why: Bithoor's holiest ghat, where Brahma is said to have begun creation and Valmiki's Ramayana is recited.
places.realVisit: Open all year; near Kanpur.

lessons.title: The question that starts the Ramayana
The whole story in chapter one
The two birds by the river

places.name: Rishyashringa Temple, Kigga
places.why: The temple of the rain-bringing sage Rishyashringa, who performed Dasharatha's sacrifice for sons.
places.realVisit: Open daily; near Sringeri; prayers for rain draw pilgrims in dry years.

lessons.title: The boy who brought the rain

places.name: Naya Ghat, Ayodhya
places.why: Ayodhya's main Saryu bathing ghat, where pilgrims start their day as Rama did.
places.realVisit: Open all year; Kartik Purnima bathing in November.

places.name: Nageshwarnath Temple, Ayodhya
places.why: An ancient Shiva temple at Ram ki Paidi, said to have been founded by Rama's son Kusha.
places.realVisit: Open daily; Shivaratri is the main festival.

places.name: Guptar Ghat, Ayodhya
places.why: The Saryu ghat where Rama is said to have walked into the river at the end of the Ramayana.
places.realVisit: Open all year; west of Ayodhya; a peaceful riverside walk.

places.name: Ram Rekha Ghat, Buxar
places.why: Buxar is old Siddhashrama, where Vishvamitra's sacrifice was guarded and Rama faced Tataka.
places.realVisit: Open all year; Panchkosi fair in November retraces Rama's route.

places.name: Ahilyasthan, Darbhanga
places.why: Mithila tradition says Rama freed Ahalya from her curse at this temple.
places.realVisit: Open all year; Ram Navami fair; near Darbhanga.

lessons.title: The woman no one could see

places.name: Ram Sita Vivah Mandap, Janakpur
places.why: The wedding pavilion beside Janaki Mandir that marks where Rama and Sita are said to have married.
places.realVisit: Open daily; small entry fee; Vivah Panchami in Nov-Dec reenacts the wedding.

places.name: Dhanusha Dham
places.why: Nepali tradition says a piece of Shiva's broken bow fell here; it is where Parashurama's challenge is remembered.
places.realVisit: Open all year; north of Janakpur; Makar Sankranti fair.

places.name: Kanak Bhawan, Ayodhya
places.why: Sita's palace in Ayodhya, given to her by Kaikeyi, where the court's story unfolds.
places.realVisit: Open daily; evening arti with bhajans; near Hanuman Garhi.

places.name: Rang Mahal, Ayodhya
places.why: An Ayodhya temple remembered as Sita's first home after her wedding.
places.realVisit: Open daily.

places.name: Dashrath Mahal, Ayodhya
places.why: The palace remembered as King Dasharatha's home: the night of his promise, his grief and his death.
places.realVisit: Open daily; in Ayodhya's old town near Hanuman Garhi.

lessons.title: A bow, a spade and a basket

places.name: Sita ki Rasoi, Ayodhya
places.why: A small Ayodhya shrine remembered as Sita's kitchen, near where the royal household grieved.
places.realVisit: Open daily; near the Ram Janmabhoomi temple.

places.name: Shringverpur
places.why: The Ganga crossing where the boatman-king Guha welcomed Rama and ferried the exiles across.
places.realVisit: Open all year; near Prayagraj; Guha's ghat and the excavated site.

lessons.title: The night watch on the Ganga

places.name: Bharadwaj Ashram, Prayagraj
places.why: Sage Bharadvaja's ashram near the meeting of the Ganga and Yamuna, where the exiles stopped.
places.realVisit: Open all year; near Anand Bhawan; combine with the Sangam.

places.name: Janaki Kund, Chitrakoot
places.why: A Mandakini pool in Chitrakoot where Sita is said to have bathed in exile.
places.realVisit: Open all year; boat from Ramghat.

places.name: Bharat Kund, Nandigram
places.why: Bharata ruled from Nandigram for fourteen years, keeping Rama's sandals on the throne.
places.realVisit: Open all year; south of Ayodhya; quiet.

places.name: Sati Anasuya Ashram, Chitrakoot
places.why: Atri and Anasuya's forest hermitage, where the exiles met the old forest sages.
places.realVisit: Open all year; 16 km from Chitrakoot town; monsoon swells the stream.

places.name: Ramtek
places.why: Rama is said to have rested at Ramtek during exile and met the sage Agastya nearby.
places.realVisit: Open all year; near Nagpur; Kalidasa memorial on the hill.

lessons.title: The giant who was a musician

places.name: Ramkund, Nashik
places.why: The Godavari tank in Nashik where Rama is said to have bathed during exile.
places.realVisit: Open all year; Kumbh Mela every twelve years.

lessons.title: The wound that starts a war

places.name: Tapovan, Nashik
places.why: Tradition places Lakshmana's wounding of Shurpanakha and the battle of Janasthana at Tapovan.
places.realVisit: Open all year; near Panchavati; quiet forest area.

lessons.title: The promise to the sages, kept
Rama is dharma with a body

places.name: Sita Gufa, Panchavati
places.why: The small cave in Panchavati where tradition says Sita hid and from where she was taken.
places.realVisit: Open daily; a very narrow stair down; near Kalaram temple.

lessons.title: A holy man at the door

places.name: Shabari Dham, Dang
places.why: Gujarat's forest temple to Shabari, the old woman who waited years to feed Rama.
places.realVisit: Open all year; near Subir in Dang district; monsoon is green.

places.name: Anegundi, Kishkindha
places.why: The village across the Tungabhadra from Hampi, revered as Kishkindha, Sugriva's monkey kingdom.
places.realVisit: Open all year; cross by coracle or road from Hampi.

places.name: Chintamani Temple, Anegundi
places.why: A riverside cave temple at Anegundi where Rama is said to have watched the fight of Vali and Sugriva.
places.realVisit: Open all year.

places.name: Malyavanta Raghunatha Temple, Hampi
places.why: Hampi tradition says Rama waited out the monsoon on this hill while Sugriva gathered the army.
places.realVisit: Open daily; a short climb; sunsets are lovely.

places.name: Virupaksha Temple, Hampi
places.why: Hampi's living temple at the heart of Kishkindha country, where the search for Sita is retold.
places.realVisit: Open daily; elephant blessing in mornings; Hampi Utsav in winter.

places.name: Jatayu Earth's Center, Chadayamangalam
places.why: A rock where Kerala tradition says Jatayu fell, now crowned by a giant sculpture of the bird.
places.realVisit: Open daily; ropeway up; near Kollam.

places.name: Mahendragiri
places.why: The Ramayana's Mount Mahendra, the southern peak from which Hanuman is said to have leapt across the sea.
places.realVisit: Most of the hill is restricted; view from the foothills; winter is best.

lessons.title: The trees that saw him off

places.name: Ramanathaswamy Temple, Rameswaram
places.why: Rama is said to have worshipped Shiva here before crossing to Lanka; it holds the longest temple corridor in India.
places.realVisit: Open daily; bathe at Agni Theertham; October to March.

places.name: Kothandaramaswamy Temple, Rameswaram
places.why: The sand-surrounded temple where tradition says Vibhishana surrendered to Rama.
places.realVisit: Open daily.

places.name: Sigiriya
places.why: Sri Lankan Ravana tradition places a palace on this great rock; it stands for golden Lanka in many local tellings.
places.realVisit: Open daily; a steep climb, start early; dry season is January to April.

places.name: Pidurangala Rock
places.why: The rock beside Sigiriya with a view of the whole fortress, standing in for Lanka's walls.
places.realVisit: A short climb, best at sunrise.

places.name: Hakgala Botanical Garden
places.why: Sri Lankan tradition places part of Ravana's pleasure garden, where Sita was held, at Hakgala.
places.realVisit: Open daily; near Nuwara Eliya; roses bloom April to August.

places.name: Ussangoda
places.why: Local tradition says this red, barren clifftop is where Hanuman's burning tail scorched Lanka.
places.realVisit: Open all year; a national park near Ambalantota; go at sunset.

places.name: Ravana Cave, Ella
places.why: A cliff cave above Ella where Sri Lankan tradition says Ravana hid Sita.
places.realVisit: A short steep climb from the Ella road.

places.name: Little Adam's Peak, Ella
places.why: A green hill above Ella, in the land where Sri Lanka's Ravana stories end.
places.realVisit: Open all year; an easy hike from Ella.

places.name: Unawatuna Bay
places.why: The bay under Rumassala hill, where tradition says part of Hanuman's herb mountain fell.
places.realVisit: Open all year; near Galle.

places.name: Sita Samahit Sthal, Sitamarhi (Bhadohi)
places.why: Tradition holds that Sita returned to the earth here; a temple marks the spot by the Ganga.
places.realVisit: Open all year; between Prayagraj and Varanasi.

lessons.title: Sita goes home to the earth

places.name: Govind Dev Ji Temple, Jaipur
places.why: Jaipur's royal Krishna temple anchors a city that celebrates every festival with music and lamps.
places.realVisit: Open for seven darshans daily; Janmashtami and Holi are joyful and crowded.

lessons.title: Janmashtami: the night Krishna was born
Ganesh Chaturthi: the guest who wants love
Navaratri: nine nights of the Goddess

places.name: Nand Bhavan, Nandgaon
places.why: Krishna's hilltop village opposite Barsana, where Holi is played and the gopis' longing is sung.
places.realVisit: Open daily; Lathmar Holi in February-March; Pavan Sarovar below.

lessons.title: Maha Shivaratri: the great night of Shiva
Raksha Bandhan: the thread of protection

places.name: Uddhav Kyari, Nandgaon
places.why: The grove where tradition says Uddhava met the gopis and learned the depth of their love.
places.realVisit: Open all year.

places.name: Mumba Devi Temple, Mumbai
places.why: The Goddess Mumbai is named for, at the heart of a city that throws itself into every festival.
places.realVisit: Open daily; in the Bhuleshwar market district; Navaratri is festive.

places.name: Chamundeshwari Temple, Mysore
places.why: The Goddess of Mysore's hill, center of the ten-day Dasara, presides over these festival days.
places.realVisit: Open daily; 1,000 steps or road; Dasara in Sept-Oct.

lessons.title: Maha Shivaratri: the great night of Shiva
Raksha Bandhan: the thread of protection

places.name: Mansa Devi Temple, Haridwar
places.why: The hilltop Goddess temple above Har ki Pauri, reached by ropeway.
places.realVisit: Open daily.

lessons.title: Rantideva's last cup: whose is wealth?

lessons.spot: Har Ki Pauri ghat steps west
lessons.title: Arjuna drops his bow: work that doesn't cling
Ajamila's last word: the name at the end

places.name: Mannarasala Sree Nagaraja Temple
places.why: Kerala's great serpent temple in a sacred grove, a fitting home for the Mahabharata's opening tales of snakes.
places.realVisit: Open daily; near Haripad, Alappuzha; Ayilyam festival in Oct-Nov.

lessons.title: A story told beside a fire

places.name: Kukke Subramanya Temple
places.why: A forest temple where the serpent Vasuki is said to have sheltered from Garuda; the epic's snake stories live here.
places.realVisit: Open daily; monsoon is heavy; Kumara Parvatha trek starts here.

places.name: Garhmukteshwar Ganga Ghat
places.why: An old Ganga crossing of the Kuru country where the river goddess and the Kuru kings meet in story, and families still offer rites for the dead.
places.realVisit: Open all year; the Kartik Purnima fair in November is huge.

lessons.title: The king who looked too long

places.name: Brijghat
places.why: The Ganga ghat on the old Delhi road where families bring their dead and grief is offered to the river.
places.realVisit: Open all year.

lessons.title: where dharma is, there is victory

places.name: Vashisht Temple, Manali
places.why: The Himalayan village and hot springs of the sage Vasishtha, whose wish-giving cow Nandini starts Bhishma's story.
places.realVisit: Open daily; hot spring baths; snowbound in deep winter.

places.name: Birla Gita Mandir, Kurukshetra
places.why: A Kurukshetra temple whose walls carry Gita verses, near the field of Bhishma's vow and fall.
places.realVisit: Open daily; near Brahma Sarovar.

places.name: Vyas Teela, Kalpi
places.why: Kalpi on the Yamuna is revered as the birthplace of Vyasa, son of the ferry-girl Satyavati.
places.realVisit: Open all year; on the Kanpur-Jhansi highway; quiet riverside.

places.name: Assi Ghat, Varanasi
places.why: Kashi's southern ghat; the princesses of Kashi, including Amba, were carried off from this city.
places.realVisit: Open all year; Subah-e-Banaras morning ritual daily; quieter than the main ghats.

lessons.title: The vow that would not bend

places.name: Pandeshwar Mahadev Temple, Hastinapur
places.why: An old Shiva temple of Hastinapur, said to be where the Pandavas worshipped, near where the dice game was played.
places.realVisit: Open all year; in Hastinapur town.

places.name: Yogadhyan Badri, Pandukeshwar
places.why: The Himalayan village where Pandu is said to have lived in the forest and the Pandavas were born.
places.realVisit: Open in the Badrinath season, May to November; on the Badrinath road.

places.name: Karnaprayag
places.why: Where the Alaknanda meets the Pindar; tradition says Karna worshipped the sun here.
places.realVisit: Open all year; on the Badrinath road; monsoon brings landslides.

lessons.title: Kunti meets Karna by the river

places.name: Karnagarh, Bhagalpur
places.why: Karnagarh is remembered as the seat of Karna, king of Anga, famed for giving.
places.realVisit: Open all year; in Bhagalpur, Bihar; Champanagar temples nearby.

places.name: Lakshagriha, Barnawa
places.why: Barnawa, old Varanavata, is where the Kauravas built the house of lac to burn the Pandavas.
places.realVisit: Open all year; near Baghpat, Uttar Pradesh; local guides show the tunnel.

places.name: Vidur Kuti, Bijnor
places.why: The ashram of Vidura on the Ganga, where Krishna ate simply with the wise uncle.
places.realVisit: Open all year; near Bijnor; quiet.

places.name: Kampil, Kampilya
places.why: Kampilya was King Drupada's capital, where Draupadi was born of fire and chose her husband.
places.realVisit: Open all year; in Farrukhabad district; Draupadi Kund is nearby.

places.name: Purana Qila, Delhi
places.why: Delhi's Old Fort stands on what tradition and excavation link to Indraprastha, the Pandavas' city.
places.realVisit: Open daily; light show in evenings; winter is best.

lessons.title: Fear not: Maya spared from the fire
Gentle words for an angry guest

places.name: Nigambodh Ghat, Delhi
places.why: An ancient Yamuna ghat of Delhi linked by tradition to Indraprastha and the Pandavas' last rites.
places.realVisit: Open all year; north of Delhi's Red Fort.

lessons.title: Parikshit and the act of truth

places.name: Yogmaya Temple, Mehrauli
places.why: An ancient Goddess temple in Delhi, said to date back to the Pandavas' city.
places.realVisit: Open daily; near the Qutub complex; Phoolwalon ki Sair festival in autumn.

places.name: Rajon ki Baoli, Mehrauli
places.why: A stepwell in Mehrauli near the old Yogmaya temple, a place of water that looks like floor.
places.realVisit: Open daily.

places.name: Jarasandh ka Akhara, Rajgir
places.why: Rajgir was Jarasandha's Magadha; his wrestling ground is shown here where Bhima fought him.
places.realVisit: Open daily; hot springs and the ropeway nearby; winter is best.

lessons.title: Arjuna answers the cry at the gate
Ravana and the brother who warned him
The butcher who taught a scholar

places.name: Chanderi Fort
places.why: Chanderi in old Chedi country, the kingdom of Shishupala in the Mahabharata.
places.realVisit: Open all year; famous for handwoven saris; winter is best.

places.name: Draupadi Ghat, Hastinapur
places.why: A Ganga ghat at Hastinapur named for Draupadi, where her question to the court is remembered.
places.realVisit: Open all year; a few kilometers from Hastinapur town.

places.name: Kamyakeshwar Tirtha, Kurukshetra
places.why: The Kamyaka forest of the Pandavas' exile is remembered at this tirtha near Kurukshetra.
places.realVisit: Open all year; near Kurukshetra; quiet village setting.

lessons.title: The sun's gift in the forest

places.name: Pandav Caves, Pachmarhi
places.why: Rock-cut caves in the Satpura hills that local tradition says sheltered the Pandavas in exile.
places.realVisit: Open all year; Pachmarhi is a hill station; monsoon waterfalls.

lessons.title: Vyasa sends Arjuna to the gods

places.name: Jata Shankar Cave, Pachmarhi
places.why: A gorge cave where Shiva is said to have hidden; its pools fit the yaksha's lake.
places.realVisit: Open daily.

places.name: Kanaka Durga Temple, Indrakeeladri
places.why: Tradition says Arjuna did his penance on Indrakeeladri hill and met Shiva as a hunter here.
places.realVisit: Open daily; Dasara in Sept-Oct; Prakasam Barrage view.

lessons.title: The garland on the hunter's head

places.name: Narwar Fort
places.why: Narwar is remembered as Nishadha, kingdom of Nala, whose love story with Damayanti is told in the forest.
places.realVisit: Open all year; near Shivpuri; climb to the fort in the cool morning.

lessons.title: A story for a grieving king

places.name: Kaundinyapur
places.why: Old Vidarbha's capital on the Wardha, home of Damayanti and of Rukmini.
places.realVisit: Open all year; near Amravati; Kartik fair in autumn.

places.name: Savitri Temple, Pushkar
places.why: The hilltop temple of Savitri over Pushkar; Savitri's walk behind Death is retold beneath it.
places.realVisit: Open daily; a steep climb or ropeway; go for sunrise.

places.name: Bhimtal
places.why: A Kumaon lake named for Bhima, ringed with Pandava legends, a natural home for the yaksha's lake.
places.realVisit: Open all year; near Nainital; boating on the lake.

places.name: Viratnagar (Bairat)
places.why: Bairat is ancient Viratnagar, where the Pandavas lived in disguise in King Virata's court.
places.realVisit: Open all year; between Jaipur and Alwar; Bhim ki Doongri cave nearby.

places.name: Sudama Setu, Dwarka
places.why: The footbridge across the Gomti at Dwarka named for Krishna's friend Sudama.
places.realVisit: Open daily.

places.name: Bhadrakali Temple, Kurukshetra
places.why: Kurukshetra's Shakti peeth where tradition says the Pandavas prayed before battle; the Gita's war setting all around.
places.realVisit: Open daily; devotees offer clay horses; Navaratri is busy.

lessons.title: The self that is never killed

places.name: Abhimanyupur (Amin)
places.why: Village tradition places Abhimanyu's last stand in the chakravyuha at Amin near Kurukshetra.
places.realVisit: Open all year; south of Kurukshetra; ask locals for the Aditi temple.

places.name: Karna Lake, Karnal
places.why: Karnal takes its name from Karna; the lake honors the giver-king who fell when his chariot wheel sank.
places.realVisit: Open all year; on the Delhi-Chandigarh highway; boating.

places.name: Dauji Temple, Baldeo
places.why: Baldeo's temple of Balarama, Krishna's plough-carrying brother who judged the last duel.
places.realVisit: Open daily; the Huranga after Holi is famous.

lessons.title: flowers on the man who lost

places.name: Asirgarh Fort
places.why: Local legend says Ashvatthama still wanders Asirgarh's fort and worships at its Shiva temple.
places.realVisit: Open by day; near Burhanpur; a steep road up.

places.name: Tapkeshwar Mahadev, Dehradun
places.why: A cave temple where water drips on the linga; tradition says Drona lived here and Ashvatthama was born.
places.realVisit: Open daily; in Dehradun; Shivaratri is crowded.

lessons.title: the night the Pandavas were away
the jewel and the guru's son

places.name: Ban Ganga Tirtha, Dayalpur
places.why: Where tradition says Arjuna shot an arrow into the earth to bring up water for Bhishma on his bed of arrows.
places.realVisit: Open all year; south of Kurukshetra; quiet.

lessons.title: the teacher on the bed of arrows
Bhishma on kings: the fish and the mother

places.realVisit: Drive from Eskişehir (about 100 km); Hortu village is a short drive south.

places.why: Classic Zen stories of the empty cup and the two monks are told at a great Kyoto Zen temple.
places.realVisit: Subway to Keage in Kyoto; the temple grounds are open daily.

places.name: Ryokan's hermitage, Mount Kugami
places.why: The hermit-poet Ryokan's kindness, and Hakuin's "is that so?", are told on the mountain where Ryokan lived.
places.realVisit: Train to Bunsui or Tsubame-Sanjo; a forest path climbs to Kokujo-ji and the hut.

places.realVisit: Train to Bengbu, then a short drive to Fengyang.

places.realVisit: Bus from Linfen or Yan'an; viewing paths line both banks.

places.realVisit: Fly or ferry to Samos; the Heraion and Pythagorio are on the south coast.

places.realVisit: Bus or drive about 180 km from Athens; the site and museum are open daily.
