lessons.spot: Old doorways of Sahip Ata quarter
lessons.title: Who is at the door?

places.name: The Hron, among the Quadi
places.why: Marcus wrote book one of his notebook "among the Quadi on the Granua", this river.
places.realVisit: Train to Štúrovo; riverside paths and the bridge to Esztergom are open.

lessons.spot: Esztergom Basilica from across the river
lessons.title: Not my doing

places.name: Lake Beyşehir's reed beds
places.why: The Masnavi opens with the song of a reed cut from its reed bed, taught by a lake full of reeds.
places.realVisit: Drive about 90 km west of Konya to Beyşehir town.

places.name: Alaeddin Hill, Konya
places.why: The Masnavi's king and his ailing handmaid are told on the hill of the Seljuk kings.
places.realVisit: Walk from the Mevlana Museum (about 1.5 km); the hill park is open daily.

lessons.title: A hard ending, read as allegory

places.name: Aquincum and the Danube Bend
places.why: Marcus campaigned along this stretch of the Danube, so his lines on delay and retreat are read here.
places.realVisit: Suburban train from Budapest to Aquincum; Visegrád and Szentendre are short trips north.

lessons.title: As if it were the last

places.name: Konya's bazaar
places.why: The grocer's parrot and "trust God and tie your camel" are told in the market quarter.
places.realVisit: Walk from the Mevlana Museum; the bazaar is open daily except Sunday.

places.name: Meram, Konya's orchards
places.why: The hare who outwits the lion is told in the orchards and hills where Konya went to rest.
places.realVisit: City bus or tram from central Konya to Meram.

lessons.spot: Old stone well in Sille valley
lessons.title: The lion in the well

places.name: Sirmium
places.why: An imperial city of the Danube frontier where Marcus wintered while writing his notebook.
places.realVisit: Train or bus from Belgrade (about 75 km); the ruins are under a protective roof.

places.name: Sultanhanı caravanserai
places.why: The merchant's parrot story is told at a great caravan inn on the Silk Road.
places.realVisit: Drive about 100 km east of Konya on the Aksaray road.

places.name: Medina
places.why: The old harper's story features Caliph Umar, so it is told in the city of the Prophet.
places.realVisit: Fly to Medina; the city is open to visitors, with parts of the Prophet's Mosque for Muslims.

places.name: Mount Sinai
places.why: Moses and the shepherd, Rumi's story of prayer beyond words, is told on Moses' mountain.
places.realVisit: Drive from Sharm el-Sheikh to St Catherine; climb at night with a local guide for sunrise.

places.name: Marcus' column, Rome
places.why: Marcus warns against becoming "Caesared" in the city where his column still stands.
places.realVisit: Walk from the Pantheon to Piazza Colonna; the square is open at all hours.

lessons.title: Don't be turned into a Caesar
Three acts can be the play

places.name: Baghdad on the Tigris
places.why: The snake-catcher's tale is set in Baghdad, the great city of Rumi's world.
places.realVisit: Fly to Baghdad when travel advice allows; the riverside and book market are open on Fridays.

places.name: Vindobona, Vienna
places.why: Marcus died near here; his last lessons on kindness and being one are read in Vienna.
places.realVisit: Metro to Stephansplatz; the Roman Museum at Hoher Markt is open daily.

places.name: Konya's whirling hall
places.why: Rumi's ghazals and the turning ceremony are taught where the sema is still performed.
places.realVisit: Weekly sema ceremonies run in Konya, and the Şeb-i Arus festival each December.

lessons.spot: Şeb-i Arus candles near the tomb
lessons.title: The wedding night

places.name: Sille, the old Greek village by Konya
places.why: The camp keeps one story from Rumi and spots the fake quotes in a village where Muslims and Christians lived side by side.
places.realVisit: Bus from central Konya (about 8 km).

places.name: Cappadocia
places.why: The Rumi and Marcus camp closes in a landscape of rock chapels and balloons, Anatolia's wonder.
places.realVisit: Fly to Kayseri or Nevşehir; Göreme is the base for valleys and the open-air museum.

lessons.title: Camp 4 close: the reed and the emperor

places.name: Ayodhya on the Saryu
places.why: Namaste, home worship and Diwali are taught in the city whose homecoming Diwali celebrates.
places.realVisit: Train or fly to Ayodhya; Diwali's lamp festival on the ghats is the time to go.

lessons.title: Hinduism: the lamp and the flower

places.name: Bodh Gaya
places.why: Buddhism is met where Siddhartha sat under the tree and woke up.
places.realVisit: Fly to Gaya; the temple grounds are open from early morning to night.

lessons.title: Buddhism: the man under the tree

places.name: Sarnath
places.why: The Buddha taught the middle way first at this deer park.
places.realVisit: Drive about 10 km from Varanasi; the park and museum are open daily.

lessons.spot: Chaukhandi Stupa under the full moon
lessons.title: Vesak, the full moon

places.name: Sea of Galilee
places.why: Jesus taught the great commandments, the Beatitudes and the Lord's Prayer by this lake.
places.realVisit: Drive or bus from Tiberias; the shore churches and hillside are open daily.

lessons.spot: Wildflower slopes below the Mount of Beatitudes
lessons.title: Consider the lilies

places.name: Jerusalem's Easter road
places.why: Grace and Easter are taught on the road Christians walk to the empty tomb.
places.realVisit: Walk the Via Dolorosa in the Old City; the church is open daily.

lessons.spot: Holy Sepulchre courtyard at Easter dawn
lessons.title: Christianity: Easter

places.name: Bethlehem
places.why: Christmas is taught on the fields of the shepherds.
places.realVisit: Bus or tour from Jerusalem through the checkpoint; Shepherds' Field is in Beit Sahour.

places.name: St Peter's, Rome
places.why: The Mass, the rosary and the saints are taught at the heart of the Catholic world.
places.realVisit: Metro to Ottaviano; the square and basilica are open daily, free.

lessons.spot: Basilica of St Paul Outside the Walls
lessons.title: Catholic: the saints

places.name: Lourdes
places.why: Sacred reading, the Hail Mary, works of mercy and Lent are taught at the great Marian shrine.
places.realVisit: Train to Lourdes; the sanctuary is open day and night.

lessons.spot: Stations of the Cross on the Espélugues hill
lessons.title: Lent, forty days

places.name: Istanbul's mosques
places.why: One God, five prayers, remembrance and mercy are taught among the great mosques of Istanbul.
places.realVisit: Tram to Sultanahmet; mosques welcome visitors outside prayer times.

lessons.spot: Süleymaniye courtyard on the Night of Power
lessons.title: The Night of Power

places.name: Al-Azhar, Cairo
places.why: Giving, good character and Ramadan are taught in old Cairo, where lanterns light the fasting month.
places.realVisit: Taxi to Al-Azhar Mosque in Islamic Cairo; open to visitors outside prayer.

places.name: Kartarpur Sahib
places.why: Guru Nanak farmed and taught here for his last years, so one creator, the name and honest work are taught here.
places.realVisit: Indian pilgrims use the visa-free Kartarpur Corridor from Dera Baba Nanak.

places.name: Anandpur Sahib
places.why: Vaisakhi is taught where the Khalsa was founded at the spring harvest.
places.realVisit: Train to Anandpur Sahib; Hola Mohalla and Vaisakhi are the busiest days.

places.name: Athens' schools: Stoa of Attalos and the Lyceum
places.why: The Stoics' core ideas are taught in the rebuilt colonnade of the Agora and at Aristotle's school.
places.realVisit: Metro to Monastiraki; the Agora and Lyceum sites are open daily.

lessons.spot: Church of the Holy Apostles in the Agora
lessons.title: Four virtues

places.name: Rhodes
places.why: Posidonius taught the Stoic view of emotions on Rhodes.
places.realVisit: Fly or ferry to Rhodes; the acropolis of Monte Smith is open to walkers.

places.name: Kition, Zeno's home
places.why: Zeno, founder of the Stoics, was born here; living by nature is taught in his hometown.
places.realVisit: Fly to Larnaca; Kition ruins and the salt lake are in town.

places.name: Sinop, Diogenes' birthplace
places.why: Diogenes, citizen of the world, was born on this Black Sea cape.
places.realVisit: Fly to Sinop or take the coastal road from Samsun.

places.name: Gyaros and Syros, Musonius' exile
places.why: Musonius Rufus, teacher of Epictetus, was exiled to bare Gyaros and kept teaching.
places.realVisit: Gyaros is protected and closed; see it from boats out of Syros.

places.name: Harvard and Cambridge
places.why: Why science belongs in the path, and the famous wandering-mind study, are taught at Harvard.
places.realVisit: Red Line to Harvard; the yard and Mount Auburn are open to walkers.

places.name: Insight Meditation Society, Barre
places.why: What meditation research shows and doesn't is taught at a center where people sit for weeks.
places.realVisit: Drive about 100 km west of Boston; IMS runs retreats, booked ahead.

places.name: Spirit Rock
places.why: Breathing research and the talking mind are taught at a meditation center in the Marin hills.
places.realVisit: Drive from San Francisco to Woodacre; Spirit Rock has day programs and retreats.

places.name: Regent's Park, London
places.why: How habits form is taught near the London university that ran the famous habit study.
places.realVisit: Tube to Regent's Park or Baker Street; the park is open daily.

places.name: Berkeley hills
places.why: Compassion, self-compassion, connection and awe research are taught where the Greater Good Science Center works.
places.realVisit: BART to Downtown Berkeley; the campus and Tilden Park are open to visitors.

places.name: Stanford Dish
places.why: The nature-walk study and expressive writing are taught on Stanford's hills.
places.realVisit: Park off Stanford Avenue; the Dish loop trail is open daily.

places.name: Hume's Edinburgh
places.why: What science can and can't say is taught in David Hume's city.
places.realVisit: Train to Edinburgh Waverley; Calton Hill is a short walk.

lessons.spot: Hume's statue on the Royal Mile
lessons.title: What science can't say

places.name: Sedona
places.why: Spotting a sales funnel dressed as teaching is taught honestly in a center of the spiritual marketplace.
places.realVisit: Drive about 2 hours north of Phoenix; trails are free with a parking pass.

lessons.spot: Red Rock Crossing on Oak Creek
lessons.title: The body scan in the rule

places.name: Glastonbury
places.why: Seekers of every kind gather here, a fit place to keep what you loved and leave what you didn't.
places.realVisit: Train to Castle Cary, then bus; the Tor, abbey and Chalice Well are open to visitors.

places.name: Mount Fuji summit
places.why: Year one ends at a great lookout, looking back down the hill and ahead to four more ranges.
places.realVisit: Climb in July or August from the Fujinomiya or Yoshida trail, overnight in a mountain hut.

places.name: Preveza, the Handbook's harbour
places.why: Year two opens Epictetus' Handbook in the harbour town beside his school.
places.realVisit: Fly to Preveza-Aktion; the old town and fortresses are walkable.

places.name: Hierapolis, Epictetus' birthplace
places.why: Epictetus was born here, enslaved, so his lessons on baths and judgments are read by its hot springs.
places.realVisit: Fly to Denizli; Pamukkale and Hierapolis share one ticket.

lessons.title: The horse is handsome, not you

places.name: Actium strait
places.why: Epictetus' captain calling passengers back to the ship is read where ships have crossed for two thousand years.
places.realVisit: Walk or drive to Aktio across the undersea tunnel from Preveza.

places.name: Kassope
places.why: The Handbook's lessons on what you have for each event are read in a mountain city of Epirus.
places.realVisit: Drive about 30 km north of Preveza; the site is open daily.

lessons.title: What do I have for this?

places.name: Athens' Kerameikos and the Garden
places.why: Crates, Epicurus' Garden and the Handbook's banquet are read in the old quarter by the city gate.
places.realVisit: Metro to Kerameikos; the site and museum are open daily.

places.name: Epidaurus
places.why: Life as a play, omens and contests are read in the most perfect theatre of the ancient world.
places.realVisit: Drive about 2 hours from Athens; summer festival performances run in the theatre.

places.name: The Acheron river
places.why: Keeping death before your eyes is read by the river the Greeks called the way to the underworld.
places.realVisit: Drive about 60 km north of Preveza; walk up the river from Glyki.

places.name: Arta
places.why: Small Handbook lessons about lettuce, cups and being handed over are read in a market town of Epirus.
places.realVisit: Drive about 50 km from Preveza; the bridge and market are in town.

lessons.title: A target isn't set up to be missed

places.name: Olympia
places.why: Epictetus uses the Olympic Games and Zeus' great statue as images, so those lessons are read here.
places.realVisit: Train or drive from Pyrgos; the site and museum are open daily.

places.name: Dodona
places.why: Reverence and "no oracle needed" are read at Greece's oldest oracle.
places.realVisit: Drive about 20 km from Ioannina; the site is open daily.

places.name: The Ambracian Gulf
places.why: Speak rarely and simply: quiet lessons on a calm gulf of lagoons and fishing boats.
places.realVisit: Drive from Preveza or Arta to Koronisia; birding and boat trips run in season.

places.name: Tzoumerka mountains
places.why: Show the wool, not the fodder: progress is read among the shepherds' high pastures.
places.realVisit: Drive from Ioannina or Arta; villages have guesthouses and trails.

places.name: Assos, Cleanthes' town
places.why: The Handbook closes with Cleanthes' prayer, read in the town where he was born.
places.realVisit: Drive from Çanakkale (about 90 km) to Behramkale.

places.name: Preveza coast
places.why: Epictetus taught a few miles north at Nicopolis; his blunt Discourses on judgment open on this shore.
places.realVisit: Fly to Aktion airport (PVK) and walk the Preveza seafront; Nicopolis is a 7 km drive north.

lessons.spot: Preveza, the old fish market quay
lessons.title: Test the coin

places.name: The Ambracian Gulf
places.why: The calm inland sea beside Nicopolis frames lessons on standing firm and knowing who you are.
places.realVisit: Drive the gulf shore road from Preveza to Vonitsa and Koronisia in a day.

lessons.spot: Actium, Roman remains at Aktio point
lessons.title: Stand firm

places.name: Kassope and Zalongo
places.why: A hilltop city of Epictetus' own region, good for lessons on habits, calm days and steady practice.
places.realVisit: Kassope sits 25 km north of Preveza; a short walk joins it to the Zalongo monument.

places.name: River Acheron
places.why: The ancients' river of the underworld frames Epictetus on fear, death and the free will no one can take.
places.realVisit: From Parga drive 20 km to Glyki and wade the Acheron springs; the Necromanteion is near Mesopotamo.

places.name: Dodona
places.why: Greece's oldest oracle, where people asked the oak about the future, suits lessons on enduring illness and training in private.
places.realVisit: Dodona is 22 km south of Ioannina; the site and theatre are open daily.

places.name: Ithaca
places.why: Odysseus' island, where Epictetus' lessons on home, seasons and freedom find their story.
places.realVisit: Ferry from Kefalonia (Sami) to Ithaca; Vathy harbor and the cave are walkable.

lessons.spot: Ithaca, Cave of the Nymphs path
lessons.title: At home here

places.name: Parga
places.why: A guarded coastal fortress town for closing the Discourses: stay at your post, keep attention.
places.realVisit: Parga is 70 km north of Preveza by coast road; walk up to the castle at sunset.

places.name: Seneca's Córdoba
places.why: Seneca was born in Córdoba; the letters to Lucilius begin in his hometown.
places.realVisit: Fly or take the train to Córdoba; the Roman temple, bridge and Seneca statue are a short walk apart.

lessons.spot: Córdoba, Seneca statue at Puerta de Almodóvar
lessons.title: Nowhere and everywhere

places.name: Posillipo
places.why: Seneca wrote often from the Bay of Naples; this headland of villas frames friendship and the fear of death.
places.realVisit: From Naples take bus 140 to Posillipo; the Pausilypon tunnel and park are open by booking.

places.name: Seneca's Rome
places.why: Seneca lived in Nero's Rome; theatres, crowds and the Tiber frame his lessons on company and examples.
places.realVisit: All spots are walkable in central Rome in an afternoon.

lessons.spot: Theatre of Pompey remains, Campo de' Fiori
lessons.title: The living voice

places.name: Seneca's farm at Nomentum
places.why: Seneca owned a country estate at Nomentum; he wrote there about old plane trees and treating each day as whole.
places.realVisit: Mentana is 25 km northeast of Rome by bus; the Nomentana road leads out from Porta Pia.

places.name: Baiae
places.why: The Roman luxury resort Seneca criticized; a sharp place for lessons on real joy and dying daily.
places.realVisit: Take the Cumana train from Naples to Baia; the archaeological park and underwater park are nearby.

places.name: Pompeii and Vesuvius
places.why: Cities buried in a day under Vesuvius make Seneca's rehearsal of the end and his warnings against show concrete.
places.realVisit: Take the Circumvesuviana train to Pompei Scavi; a bus climbs to the Vesuvius crater trail.

places.name: Lake Nemi
places.why: Seneca wrote of a sacred grove and a cave that make you feel a god is near; Nemi was Diana's grove.
places.realVisit: Nemi is 30 km south of Rome; walk the path down from the village to the lake.

lessons.spot: Temple of Diana Nemorensis, the sacred grove
lessons.title: The god within

places.name: Ostia Antica
places.why: Rome's port city full of slaves, freedmen and workers frames Seneca's letter "they're people."
places.realVisit: Take the train from Rome Porta San Paolo to Ostia Antica, 30 minutes.

lessons.spot: Ostia, the Square of the Corporations
lessons.title: Treat those below you

places.name: Puteoli and the Phlegraean coast
places.why: Seneca sailed to Puteoli seasick, visited Vatia's villa, lodged over a bath and walked the dark tunnel to Naples.
places.realVisit: The Cumana and Metro line 2 trains from Naples stop at Pozzuoli; the Crypta Neapolitana is at Piedigrotta.

places.name: Cumae
places.why: The Sibyl's ancient town near Seneca's coast holds his letters on grief, memory and learning late.
places.realVisit: Cumae is 4 km from the Fusaro Cumana station; the park is open daily.

lessons.spot: Cumae, the acropolis Temple of Jupiter
lessons.title: Let memory be sweet

places.name: Liternum
places.why: Seneca visited Scipio's plain villa at Liternum and wrote of its small dark bath.
places.realVisit: Liternum archaeological park is near Lago Patria, 30 km north of Naples by car.

lessons.spot: Liternum archaeological area, the small theatre
lessons.title: Stage kings and masks

places.name: The Alban Hills
places.why: Cicero's Tusculum and the villas south of Rome frame Seneca's letters on learning and belonging to one body.
places.realVisit: Trains from Roma Termini reach Frascati and Castel Gandolfo in 30 minutes.

places.name: The Appian Way
places.why: Rome's old road of tombs frames Seneca's letters on living for others and teachers who changed him.
places.realVisit: Rent a bike at the Appia Antica park office and ride from Porta San Sebastiano.

places.name: Nero's Golden House
places.why: Nero's gilded palace is the perfect place for Seneca on true riches against surface shine.
places.realVisit: Book a guided visit to the Domus Aurea on the Oppian Hill in central Rome.

places.name: Seneca and Nero's court
places.why: Seneca's wealth and his years as Nero's tutor need honest telling in the places of imperial power.
places.realVisit: Walk from the Palatine to the Mausoleum of Augustus through central Rome.

places.name: Taormina
places.why: Lucilius, the friend of the letters, governed Sicily; On Tranquility opens on restless travel and serving where you can.
places.realVisit: Trains reach Taormina-Giardini; a bus climbs to the town and theatre.

places.name: Syracuse
places.why: Syracuse, Sicily's great Greek city, holds the end of On Tranquility: less to lose, books to use, play, and Canus at the board.
places.realVisit: Syracuse has trains from Catania; Ortigia and the archaeological park are walkable.

places.name: Plato's Academy
places.why: Seneca tells how Plato held back his raised hand in anger; his Academy is where On Anger is taught.
places.realVisit: Take the metro to Sepolia or a bus to the Akadimia Platonos park in northwest Athens.

places.name: Capua
places.why: Capua's great amphitheatre and gladiator schools set Seneca's On Providence and the happy life.
places.realVisit: Trains from Naples reach Santa Maria Capua Vetere; the amphitheatre is near the station.

places.name: The Janiculum
places.why: From Rome's high Janiculum both "cities," the town and the world, are in view for On Benefits.
places.realVisit: Walk up from Trastevere to Piazza Garibaldi.

places.name: Aléria, Roman Corsica
places.why: Seneca's eight years of exile were in Corsica; Aléria was the island's Roman capital.
places.realVisit: Aléria is on Corsica's east coast, 70 km south of Bastia by car.

places.name: Via Appia, the fourth milestone
places.why: Seneca died at a villa about four miles from Rome; a Roman tomb here is still called the Tomb of Seneca.
places.realVisit: Ride or walk the Appia Antica past Capo di Bove to km 5.

places.name: Marcus' Rome
places.why: Marcus was born near the Lateran on the Caelian Hill; his reading begins in his home city.
places.realVisit: All spots are a 30-minute walk apart in central Rome; the bronze original is in the Capitoline Museums.

lessons.spot: Capitoline Museums, the Marcus Aurelius bronze hall
lessons.title: Between two teachers

places.name: Anagni and Segni
places.why: Marcus wrote to Fronto from a holiday near Anagnia and Signia; his debts to teachers fit these hill towns.
places.realVisit: Trains from Rome reach Anagni-Fiuggi; Segni is a short drive.

places.name: Chaeronea
places.why: Marcus' teacher Sextus came from Chaeronea, Plutarch's town; the lessons of his teachers continue here.
places.realVisit: Chaeronea is on the old road from Athens to Delphi, 120 km by car.

places.name: Brigetio and the Quadi frontier
places.why: Book two of the Meditations was written among the Quadi on this stretch of the Danube.
places.realVisit: Komárom (Hungary) and Komárno (Slovakia) face each other across a bridge; Iža fort is 7 km east.

lessons.title: Throw away the thirst for books

places.name: Trenčín
places.why: A Roman legion carved its winter of 179 into Trenčín's castle rock during Marcus' wars.
places.realVisit: Trenčín is on the Bratislava–Žilina rail line; the inscription is under the castle.

lessons.spot: Trenčín castle rock, the Roman inscription
lessons.title: Ready to leave

places.name: Gerulata and Devín
places.why: The Danube limes near Bratislava, where Marcus campaigned, frames lessons on honesty and justice.
places.realVisit: Bratislava city buses reach Rusovce and Devín.

places.name: The Wachau
places.why: The Danube's Wachau valley was the Roman frontier; its stillness suits Marcus on living only now.
places.realVisit: Trains run Vienna–Krems; boats and bikes run the valley to Melk.

places.name: Lauriacum
places.why: Lauriacum (Enns) was a legion base of Marcus' frontier; fire eating obstacles fits a camp town.
places.realVisit: Enns is on the Vienna–Linz rail line.

lessons.spot: Enns river mouth at the Danube
lessons.title: Take away the opinion

places.name: Imperial Rome
places.why: Emperors' tombs and columns frame Marcus on fame forgetting and the age of Vespasian.
places.realVisit: Walk from the Colosseum to Castel Sant'Angelo in an hour.

lessons.spot: Piazza Colonna, Column of Marcus Aurelius
lessons.title: Time gained

lessons.spot: Temple of Hadrian, Piazza di Pietra
lessons.title: Do less

places.name: Alsium coast
places.why: Marcus wrote to Fronto from the sea villas at Alsium; the headland lessons belong on this shore.
places.realVisit: Trains from Rome reach Ladispoli and Santa Severa.

places.name: Ephesus
places.why: Heraclitus of Ephesus taught that all flows like a river; Marcus returned to him often.
places.realVisit: Fly to Izmir; Selçuk is an hour by train, Ephesus 3 km from town.

lessons.title: How am I using my soul?

places.name: Smyrna
places.why: Marcus visited Smyrna in 176; its agora and hills frame the everyday irritations he wrote about.
places.realVisit: All spots are in central Izmir.

places.name: Eleusis
places.why: Marcus was initiated at Eleusis in 176; its sanctuary frames returning to yourself and being shown wrong.
places.realVisit: Eleusis is 20 km west of Athens by bus.

places.name: Lanuvium and the Alban hills
places.why: Antoninus Pius, Marcus' adoptive father, came from Lanuvium; the lessons on him and on principles live here.
places.realVisit: Trains and buses from Rome reach Lanuvio, Genzano and Ariccia.

places.name: Viminacium
places.why: A great Roman city on Marcus' Danube frontier frames his thoughts on the idle show and the holy bond.
places.realVisit: Viminacium is 90 km east of Belgrade near Kostolac.

places.name: Singidunum (Belgrade)
places.why: Roman Singidunum guarded the Danube in Marcus' wars; love for those who stumble and the wrestling art fit here.
places.realVisit: All spots are reachable by Belgrade city transport.

places.name: The Iron Gates
places.why: Trajan carved his road into this Danube gorge; Marcus' frontier summit, where his plain lessons on character stand.
places.realVisit: Drive or take a boat tour from Kladovo or Orșova into the Kazan gorge.

places.name: Aquileia
places.why: Marcus wintered at Aquileia during the plague of 168; its springs and light fit the pure-spring lessons.
places.realVisit: Aquileia is 40 km from Trieste by bus; Grado is 10 km south.

lessons.title: Not the whole life at once

places.name: Lake Neusiedl
places.why: The shallow steppe lake south of Carnuntum frames Marcus on people made for one another.
places.realVisit: Trains from Vienna reach Neusiedl am See; bikes circle the lake.

lessons.title: Death as a work of nature

places.name: Castra Regina (Regensburg)
places.why: Castra Regina was founded on the Danube in 179, near the end of Marcus' reign.
places.realVisit: Regensburg is 1.5 hours from Munich by train; Weltenburg by boat from Kelheim.

places.name: Pula and Istria
places.why: Pula's Roman arena and coast hold Marcus' late lessons on keeping your names and living as if on a mountain.
places.realVisit: Pula has an airport and ferries; Brijuni boats leave from Fažana.

lessons.title: Let no one say it truly

places.name: Fruška Gora
places.why: The wooded hills above Roman Sirmium, where Marcus spent long winters, frame his last books.
places.realVisit: Novi Sad is the gateway; buses and cars reach Sremski Karlovci and the national park.

places.name: Athens of Herodes Atticus
places.why: Marcus funded chairs of philosophy in Athens with his friend Herodes Atticus; his teaching on the will and good examples is taught here.
places.realVisit: All spots are in central Athens.

places.name: Alexandria
places.why: Marcus visited Alexandria in 176; its great library frames fate, providence and opinion.
places.realVisit: Fly to Alexandria or take the train from Cairo; spots are a short taxi ride apart.

places.name: Lugdunum (Lyon)
places.why: Lyon's Roman theatre and martyrs of 177 belong to Marcus' reign; Seneca wrote of the burned city rising.
places.realVisit: All spots are in central Lyon by funicular and foot.

places.name: Hadrian's Villa
places.why: The villa of Hadrian, who chose Marcus' line, is where your own notebook and the close of the Meditations land.
places.realVisit: Buses from Rome Ponte Mammolo reach Tivoli; the villa is below town.

places.name: Soli, Chrysippus' town
places.why: Chrysippus came from Soli in Cilicia; lessons on the lost early Stoics start in his town.
places.realVisit: Soli Pompeiopolis is in Mezitli, a short ride west of Mersin.

places.name: Lindos
places.why: Panaetius was from Lindos on Rhodes, where Posidonius later taught; their gentler Stoicism and tides are taught here.
places.realVisit: Lindos is 50 km south of Rhodes town by bus.

places.name: Arpino
places.why: Cicero was born at Arpinum; On Duties and the Dream of Scipio are taught in his town.
places.realVisit: Arpino is 120 km southeast of Rome; trains to Isola del Liri then bus.

places.name: Maroneia
places.why: Hipparchia, who chose Crates and the Cynic life, came from Maroneia in Thrace.
places.realVisit: Maroneia is 30 km south of Komotini by car.

places.name: Herculaneum
places.why: Philodemus' Epicurean library was found here in the Villa of the Papyri; the Garden's teaching is read where its books survived.
places.realVisit: The Circumvesuviana train stops at Ercolano Scavi.

lessons.title: Where death is, I am not

places.name: Elis
places.why: Pyrrho the skeptic came from Elis, and Socrates' student Phaedo founded a school there.
places.realVisit: Elis is 40 km south of Patras by car.

places.name: Mieza, Aristotle's school
places.why: Aristotle taught the young Alexander at Mieza; his virtue of the middle is taught at his school.
places.realVisit: The School of Aristotle is near Naoussa in Macedonia, 90 km west of Thessaloniki.

places.name: Boethius' Pavia
places.why: Boethius wrote the Consolation of Philosophy awaiting execution; his tomb is in Pavia.
places.realVisit: Pavia is 30 minutes from Milan by train.

places.name: Leuven
places.why: Justus Lipsius taught Stoic constancy in Leuven during Europe's wars of religion.
places.realVisit: Leuven is 25 minutes from Brussels by train.

places.name: Spinoza's Rijnsburg
places.why: Spinoza ground lenses in a small cottage in Rijnsburg; his calm through understanding is taught there.
places.realVisit: Rijnsburg is a short bus ride from Leiden station.

places.name: Philadelphia, the therapy founders
places.why: Aaron Beck built cognitive therapy at Penn, drawing on Epictetus; modern Stoicism is taught here, carefully.
places.realVisit: University of Pennsylvania is a short subway ride from Philadelphia center.

places.name: Rome of Janus
places.why: January is named for Janus, the two-faced god of doors; the Stoic new year starts at his arch.
places.realVisit: The Arch of Janus is in the Velabro, near the Bocca della Verità.

places.name: Chichén Itzá at equinox
places.why: At the equinox a serpent of light runs down El Castillo; the image of balance.
places.realVisit: Fly to Cancún or Mérida; the site is two hours by road.

places.name: Prague's Jewish Quarter
places.why: Prague's Jewish Town keeps a neighbor's Day of Atonement and the old customs of mourning.
places.realVisit: The Jewish Museum ticket covers the synagogues and cemetery in Josefov.

places.name: Avebury at midsummer
places.why: The great stone circle at Avebury marks the summer solstice.
places.realVisit: Avebury is in Wiltshire, 40 minutes from Swindon by bus.

places.name: The olive sea of Amfissa
places.why: A million olive trees below Delphi frame Marcus' ripe olive falling, blessing the tree.
places.realVisit: Drive down from Delphi to Amfissa and Itea.

places.name: Mnajdra at equinox
places.why: Mnajdra's ancient temple aligns with the equinox sunrise; balance again.
places.realVisit: Mnajdra is on Malta's south coast near Qrendi.

places.name: Newgrange at midwinter
places.why: Newgrange's passage fills with light at the winter solstice; the longest night ends.
places.realVisit: Brú na Bóinne visitor centre runs shuttles; it is an hour north of Dublin.

places.name: Capri
places.why: Island mornings and evenings frame a Stoic birthday, morning and evening routine.
places.realVisit: Ferries from Naples and Sorrento reach Capri in under an hour.

places.name: Rome of ordinary life
places.why: Markets, apartments and family tombs show Stoicism at work, at home and in grief.
places.realVisit: All in central Rome; the columbarium is in Parco degli Scipioni.

places.name: Pergamon
places.why: Galen, physician to Marcus, trained at Pergamon's healing sanctuary; anger, illness, success and failure are taught here.
places.realVisit: Bergama is 100 km north of Izmir; a cable car climbs to the acropolis.

places.name: Cape Sounion
places.why: Poseidon's temple at the tip of Attica looks out to the whole world; love, citizenship and limits are taught here.
places.realVisit: Buses run from Athens along the coast to Sounion in 90 minutes.

places.name: Aegina
places.why: Across the gulf from Athens, Aegina is a calm place to sort what you keep and leave after a year on the porch.
places.realVisit: Ferries from Piraeus reach Aegina in 40 minutes to an hour.

places.name: Laodicea
places.why: Laodicea neighbors Hierapolis, Epictetus' birthplace; thanking the three Stoic teachers begins near his home.
places.realVisit: Laodicea is 6 km north of Denizli, 10 km from Pamukkale.

places.name: Mount Olympus
places.why: The summit closes year two: look back on what Stoic practice changed and what it did not.
places.realVisit: Hike from Prionia above Litochoro to Refuge A, then Mytikas; two days with a guide.

places.name: Wadi Rum
places.why: The wide desert opens year three's six great questions, beginning with why we suffer.
places.realVisit: Fly to Aqaba; Wadi Rum village is one hour by road with Bedouin guides.

lessons.spot: Wadi Rum visitor centre, Seven Pillars
lessons.title: Six questions

places.name: Rajgir
places.why: The Buddha often taught on Vulture Peak at Rajgir; his naming of suffering is taught here.
places.realVisit: Rajgir is 100 km from Patna; Nalanda is 14 km north.

places.name: Anuradhapura
places.why: The Theravada of the Dhammapada lives in Anuradhapura, around a Bodhi tree grown from the original.
places.realVisit: Anuradhapura is 4 hours by train from Colombo.

places.name: Kushinagar
places.why: The Buddha's passing into final nirvana was at Kushinagar; the end of suffering and the path are taught here.
places.realVisit: Kushinagar has an airport and is 50 km from Gorakhpur.

places.name: Makhtesh Ramon and the Negev
places.why: Job's wilderness: losses, silent friends, argument and the whirlwind of stars, under one of the world's darkest skies.
places.realVisit: Mitzpe Ramon is 2 hours from Tel Aviv by bus; Ein Avdat is a short drive north.

places.name: Ein Gedi and Masada
places.why: David's oasis and the watchtower of Masada frame the Psalms of lament.
places.realVisit: Buses from Jerusalem reach Ein Gedi and Masada in 90 minutes.

places.name: Mount of Olives and Bethany
places.why: Where Jesus wept for Lazarus and prayed in Gethsemane, Christians meet a God who suffers with them.
places.realVisit: Walk from the Lions' Gate down to Gethsemane and up the Mount; Bethany is 2 km east.

places.name: Tarsus
places.why: Paul came from Tarsus; his thorn in the flesh is taught at his home.
places.realVisit: Tarsus is 30 km from Adana; St. Paul's Well is in the old town.

places.name: Dhofar
places.why: The tomb of the Prophet Ayyub (Job) is in the hills above Salalah; Qur'anic patience is taught here.
places.realVisit: Fly to Salalah; the tomb of Nabi Ayyub is 30 km up into the hills.

places.name: Kurukshetra
places.why: Arjuna dropped his bow on this battlefield; Krishna's teaching on pain and the uncut self begins here.
places.realVisit: Kurukshetra is 2.5 hours by train from Delhi.

places.name: Goindwal and Khadur Sahib
places.why: Early Sikh Gurus lived on the Beas at Goindwal and Khadur Sahib; sweet will and hukam are taught here.
places.realVisit: Both are 40 km from Amritsar by road.

places.name: Mengcheng, Zhuangzi's home
places.why: Mengcheng in Anhui claims Zhuangzi; his hunchback Shu, spared by uselessness, is taught here.
places.realVisit: Mengcheng is reachable by train via Bozhou in Anhui.

places.name: Norwich
places.why: Julian of Norwich heard that all shall be well; her city holds that hope.
places.realVisit: Norwich is 2 hours from London by train.

places.name: Staraya Russa
places.why: Dostoevsky wrote The Brothers Karamazov here and set it here; Ivan's rebellion is read in the town.
places.realVisit: Staraya Russa is 100 km from Veliky Novgorod by road.

places.name: Viktor Frankl's Vienna
places.why: Frankl's home city, to which he returned after the camps, teaches meaning and the last freedom.
places.realVisit: The Viktor Frankl Museum is in Mariannengasse, Vienna 9; Leopoldsberg by bus 38A.

places.name: Ivy Green, Tuscumbia
places.why: At the water pump of Ivy Green Helen Keller first understood a word; no ranking of pain.
places.realVisit: Ivy Green is in Tuscumbia, Alabama, 2 hours from Birmingham.

places.name: Mount Carmel
places.why: Elijah, exhausted and wishing to die, was fed and rested; help is strength. Carmel is his mountain.
places.realVisit: Haifa is the gateway; Muhraka is 25 km south on the ridge.

places.name: Dharamsala
places.why: Tibetan Buddhism in exile lives in McLeod Ganj; tonglen and the gentler practices are taught here.
places.realVisit: Fly to Gaggal or bus overnight from Delhi to McLeod Ganj.

places.name: Mount Pelion
places.why: Chiron, the wounded healer of myth, lived on Pelion.
places.realVisit: Volos is the gateway; buses climb to Makrinitsa and Tsagarada.

places.name: Hiroshima and Miyajima
places.why: Hiroshima's peace park teaches holding the world's suffering without going numb.
places.realVisit: Hiroshima is on the shinkansen; ferries cross to Miyajima in 10 minutes.

places.name: Jerusalem days of mourning
places.why: Tisha B'Av and Holocaust Remembrance are kept in Jerusalem's stones and at Yad Vashem.
places.realVisit: Robinson's Arch is in the Davidson Center; Yad Vashem by light rail to Mount Herzl.

lessons.spot: Yad Vashem, the Valley of Communities
lessons.title: Holocaust Remembrance Day

places.name: Antigua Guatemala
places.why: Antigua's Holy Week carpets and processions keep Good Friday.
places.realVisit: Antigua is 1 hour from Guatemala City airport.

places.name: Karbala
places.why: Shia Muslims mourn Husayn at Karbala on Ashura.
places.realVisit: Karbala is reached via Najaf or Baghdad airports; check travel advice first.

places.name: Kanazawa, the gold-leaf city
places.why: Kanazawa makes most of Japan's gold leaf, the gold of kintsugi repair; suffering's close is mended here.
places.realVisit: Kanazawa is 2.5 hours from Tokyo by shinkansen.

places.name: Cape Tainaron
places.why: The Greeks placed a gate to the underworld at Tainaron; the death questions open at land's end.
places.realVisit: Drive the Mani peninsula to Porto Sternes, then walk to the lighthouse.

places.name: Château de Montaigne, the tower
places.why: Montaigne wrote the Essays in this round tower, so his lessons on death, doubt and himself are taught at his desk.
places.realVisit: Saint-Michel-de-Montaigne, east of Bordeaux; the tower is open to visitors most of the year.

lessons.spot: The tower chapel below the library
lessons.title: Because it was he

lessons.spot: Painted Latin sayings on the library beams
lessons.title: Painted beams
The woman who carried an ox

lessons.spot: Desk corner with open book and quill
lessons.title: The essay as a practice

places.name: Vaishali
places.why: The Buddha began his last journey from Vaishali and told his monks to keep death in mind here.
places.realVisit: Vaishali is a short drive north of Patna, Bihar; the Ashokan pillar site is open daily.

places.name: Kushinagar, the last resting place
places.why: The Buddha died here, leaving the words "strive on," so his teaching on death is taught under these sal trees.
places.realVisit: Kushinagar is reached by road from Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh; the temples are open daily.

places.name: Kyoto, Higashiyama
places.why: Kyoto's eastern hills hold its old cemeteries, temples and the Obon fires that send the dead home.
places.realVisit: Higashiyama is walkable from central Kyoto; Gozan no Okuribi fires burn on 16 August.

places.name: Varanasi, Manikarnika Ghat
places.why: Hindus hold that dying in Kashi brings release, so the Gita and Nachiketa are taught beside the burning ghats.
places.realVisit: Varanasi has trains and flights from Delhi; boat rides on the Ganges run at dawn.

lessons.spot: Manikarnika Ghat steps from the river
lessons.title: Worn clothes

places.name: Safed, the old cemetery
places.why: Safed's hillside cemetery of blue tombs holds the Kaddish and the counting of days.
places.realVisit: Safed (Tzfat) is about two hours by bus from Tel Aviv; the cemetery is open to respectful visitors.

lessons.spot: Old Cemetery of Safed, blue tombs
lessons.title: Praise, not death

places.name: Assisi and the Porziuncola
places.why: Francis welcomed Sister Death here and the Angelus bells still mark midday across the valley.
places.realVisit: Assisi is a short train ride from Perugia; the Porziuncola is inside Santa Maria degli Angeli.

lessons.spot: Basilica of Santa Maria degli Angeli
lessons.title: The resurrection and the life

lessons.spot: Basilica of St Francis lower piazza at noon
lessons.title: A midday pause

places.name: Cairo, the City of the Dead
places.why: Cairo's great cemeteries are lived-in neighborhoods, where visiting graves is part of ordinary Muslim life.
places.realVisit: Cairo's Northern and Southern cemeteries can be visited with a local guide; Al-Azhar Park overlooks them.

lessons.spot: City of the Dead from Al-Azhar Park
lessons.title: Every soul shall taste death

places.name: Kiratpur Sahib
places.why: Sikh families bring ashes to the Sutlej here, where the bedtime prayer is sung at funerals.
places.realVisit: Kiratpur Sahib is on the road from Chandigarh to Anandpur Sahib in Punjab.

lessons.spot: Gurdwara Patalpuri Sahib on the Sutlej
lessons.title: Going home

places.name: Qufu, the Kong family forest
places.why: Confucius is buried in the vast family forest at Qufu, where tomb-sweeping is a living rite.
places.realVisit: The Kong Forest is a short ride north of Qufu's old city, Shandong; open daily.

lessons.spot: Wansheng gateway into the Kong Forest
lessons.title: The skull's dream

places.name: Janitzio, Lake Pátzcuaro
places.why: On the Night of the Dead, families on this island keep vigil with candles and marigolds.
places.realVisit: Boats leave for Janitzio from Pátzcuaro, Michoacán; the vigil is 1-2 November.

lessons.spot: Janitzio island cemetery on the Night of the Dead
lessons.title: Día de los Muertos

places.name: London, Highgate and beyond
places.why: London gave the world modern hospice care and the death café, and Highgate keeps its poets.
places.realVisit: Highgate Cemetery offers tours; St Christopher's Hospice is in Sydenham, south London.

lessons.spot: Highgate West Cemetery, Rossetti family grave
lessons.title: In the bleak midwinter

places.name: Mount Auburn Cemetery
places.why: America's first garden cemetery shows how the living can plan and hold death gently.
places.realVisit: Mount Auburn Cemetery is in Cambridge, Massachusetts, open daily and free.

places.name: Cannon Beach, Oregon coast
places.why: Grief comes in waves, so it is taught where the Pacific comes in wave after wave.
places.realVisit: Cannon Beach is about 90 minutes from Portland by car.

places.name: Drigung Til Monastery
places.why: Tibetan sky burial is practiced here, a rite that gives the body back to the living world.
places.realVisit: Drigung Til is a day trip from Lhasa with a permitted Tibet tour; the burial ground itself is not for tourists.

lessons.spot: Drigung Til ridge and prayer flags
lessons.title: Rites hold us

places.name: Père Lachaise Cemetery, Paris
places.why: Paris's great cemetery is a library of epitaphs, the right place to write a life in a line.
places.realVisit: Père Lachaise is in eastern Paris, by Métro line 2 or 3; open daily, free.

lessons.spot: Chestnut avenue by the Monument aux Morts
lessons.title: Honi and the carob tree

places.name: Kutná Hora and the Sedlec Ossuary
places.why: Sedlec's chapel of bones is Europe's boldest memento mori, the right room for keeping death in view.
places.realVisit: Kutná Hora is about an hour by train from Prague; the ossuary is open daily with a small ticket.

places.name: Istanbul, Eyüp hill
places.why: On Eyüp's hillside cemetery the call to sunset prayer marks each day's small ending.
places.realVisit: Eyüp is reached by ferry or bus up the Golden Horn; a cable car climbs to Pierre Loti hill.

lessons.spot: Eyüp Sultan Mosque courtyard at dawn
lessons.title: Awake again

places.name: Athens, the Ilissos
places.why: Plato set his dialogues on love beside the Ilissos stream and in Athenian homes.
places.realVisit: The Ilissos traces run near the Temple of Olympian Zeus in central Athens.

lessons.spot: Ilissos riverbed by the Temple of Artemis Agrotera
lessons.title: Many words for love

places.name: Ancient Stagira
places.why: Aristotle, who wrote of friendship as another self, was born on this headland.
places.realVisit: Ancient Stagira is near Olympiada, Halkidiki, about 90 minutes from Thessaloniki.

places.name: Beit Sahour and the Judean fields
places.why: The love of Ruth and Naomi and the Hebrew love of the stranger belong to these Bethlehem fields.
places.realVisit: Beit Sahour is just east of Bethlehem, reachable from Jerusalem by bus or taxi.

places.name: Selçuk and the Basilica of St John
places.why: Tradition says John, who wrote "God is love," lived and was buried here.
places.realVisit: Selçuk is near Ephesus, about an hour from Izmir by train.

lessons.spot: House of the Virgin Mary, Bülbüldağı
lessons.title: Washing feet

places.name: Lisieux
places.why: Thérèse of Lisieux taught the little way of love from her convent here.
places.realVisit: Lisieux is two hours by train from Paris.

places.name: Damascus, the old city
places.why: Damascus holds the Umayyad Mosque and the tomb of Ibn Arabi, whose heart could take any form.
places.realVisit: Travel to Syria depends on current advisories; the old city is walkable once there.

lessons.spot: Minaret of the Bride, Umayyad Mosque
lessons.title: The astrolabe

places.name: Ganja
places.why: Nizami, who told of Layla and Majnun, lived and is buried in Ganja.
places.realVisit: Ganja is about four hours by train from Baku.

places.name: Vrindavan
places.why: Krishna's childhood town is the home of bhakti, Mirabai's love and Radha's songs.
places.realVisit: Vrindavan is a short drive from Mathura, two to three hours from Delhi.

places.name: Lumbini
places.why: The Buddha was born here, so the boundless states of love, and his son Rahula's first practice, are taught in his birthplace.
places.realVisit: Lumbini is a few hours' drive from the Nepal-India border at Sunauli.

places.name: Cambridge Common
places.why: Attachment research grew from watching children explore and return to a safe base, as on this common.
places.realVisit: Cambridge Common is beside Harvard Square, Massachusetts.

places.name: Solesmes Abbey
places.why: Simone Weil heard the chant at Solesmes in 1938 and came to see attention itself as love.
places.realVisit: Solesmes is near Sablé-sur-Sarthe, about two hours from Paris; the monks sing public services daily.

places.name: Yasnaya Polyana
places.why: Tolstoy wrote his parables and mowed with his peasants on this estate.
places.realVisit: Yasnaya Polyana is near Tula, about three hours south of Moscow.

lessons.spot: Tolstoy's grave in the Zakaz woods
lessons.title: Accompanying the dying

places.name: Atlanta, Sweet Auburn and Emory
places.why: King preached agape at Ebenezer, and compassion research continues nearby at Emory.
places.realVisit: The King historic site is free, in central Atlanta; Emory is a short drive east.

places.name: Concord, Emerson's house
places.why: Emerson wrote Nature and his essays in this house and walked these fields.
places.realVisit: Concord is 30 minutes by train from Boston; Emerson's house opens in summer.

lessons.spot: Concord field at night under stars
lessons.title: Once in a thousand years

places.name: Bsharri and the Qadisha Valley
places.why: Gibran was born in Bsharri; his words on work, children and love are taught above his valley.
places.realVisit: Bsharri is about two and a half hours from Beirut by road.

places.name: Bevagna, Pian d'Arca
places.why: Francis preached to the birds in the fields near Bevagna and called the earth his sister.
places.realVisit: Pian d'Arca is a short drive from Bevagna, about 20 minutes south of Assisi.

places.name: Ein Kerem
places.why: A spring-fed village in the Jerusalem hills, for listening and for love that grieves.
places.realVisit: Ein Kerem is a short bus ride from central Jerusalem.

places.name: Terni
places.why: St Valentine was bishop of Terni, so the day of love is taught at his basilica.
places.realVisit: Terni is about an hour by train from Rome; the Basilica of San Valentino is on the town's edge.

places.name: Ancient Mantinea
places.why: Diotima, who taught Socrates the ladder of love, came from Mantinea.
places.realVisit: Mantinea is near Tripoli in the Peloponnese.

places.name: Degania and the Jordan valley farms
places.why: The first kibbutz farms by the Sea of Galilee carry the Bible's words on tending, sweat and rest.
places.realVisit: Degania Alef is at the south end of the Sea of Galilee.

lessons.spot: Field furrows in the Jordan valley
lessons.title: Honest sweat

lessons.spot: Sea of Galilee shore at Kinneret
lessons.title: Six days, then stop

places.name: Sepphoris and Nazareth
places.why: A Roman-era craft city near Nazareth, where a carpenter's son would have found work.
places.realVisit: Sepphoris (Tzippori) National Park is a short drive from Nazareth.

places.name: Monte Cassino
places.why: Benedict wrote his rule of prayer and work here, and the hours are still sung.
places.realVisit: Monte Cassino is reached by road from Cassino, two hours from Rome.

places.name: Wittenberg
places.why: Luther taught in Wittenberg that milking cows and sweeping floors can be a holy calling.
places.realVisit: Wittenberg is about an hour from Berlin by train; All Saints' Church is open to visitors.

places.name: Jyotisar, Kurukshetra
places.why: Tradition places Krishna's teaching to Arjuna under the banyan at Jyotisar, so the Gita's lessons on work and steady wisdom are taught here.
places.realVisit: Jyotisar is near Kurukshetra in Haryana, about three hours from Delhi by road or train.

places.name: Bosra
places.why: On the trade road from Mecca to Syria, merchants like the young Muhammad stopped at Bosra.
places.realVisit: Bosra is in southern Syria; travel depends on advisories.

places.name: Mount Baizhang
places.why: The Chan master Baizhang said a day without work is a day without food on this mountain.
places.realVisit: Mount Baizhang is near Fengxin, Jiangxi.

places.name: Grasmere and Coniston, the Lake District
places.why: Ruskin's home at Brantwood and Wordsworth's at Dove Cottage lie between these lakes.
places.realVisit: Grasmere and Coniston are a short bus ride apart in the Lake District.

lessons.title: The world is too much with us

places.name: Kelmscott Manor
places.why: William Morris, who argued for useful and beautiful work, lived here.
places.realVisit: Kelmscott Manor is near Lechlade, Oxfordshire.

places.name: Chicago lakefront
places.why: Research on flow, rest, money and happiness grew at Chicago's universities, and May Day began in this city.
places.realVisit: Chicago's Hyde Park and lakefront are a short train ride from downtown.

places.name: Ann Arbor
places.why: Research on job crafting and on nature restoring attention was done at the University of Michigan.
places.realVisit: Ann Arbor is about 45 minutes from Detroit; the Nichols Arboretum is free and open daily.

places.name: Lower Manhattan, Trinity Church
places.why: Ambition, envy and hard bosses are faced at the old church standing at the head of Wall Street.
places.realVisit: Trinity Church is on Broadway at Wall Street in Manhattan; the church and churchyard are free.

places.name: Kyoto craft quarters
places.why: Kyoto's weavers and woodworkers keep the shokunin's lifelong devotion to doing one thing well.
places.realVisit: Nishijin is in northwest Kyoto; the Nishijin Textile Center welcomes visitors.

places.name: London, the City
places.why: The working day starts and ends in London's City under St Paul's, a good place to practice at work.
places.realVisit: The City of London is central; St Paul's Cathedral sings evensong most days, free to attend.

lessons.spot: St Paul's Cathedral steps at evensong
lessons.title: Ending the workday

places.name: Plymouth harbor
places.why: The harvest thanksgiving many Americans remember is set at Plymouth harbor.
places.realVisit: Plymouth, Massachusetts, is about an hour from Boston by car or train.

places.name: Madurai
places.why: Tamil families keep the Pongal harvest festival in the fields and temple of Madurai.
places.realVisit: Madurai has flights from Chennai and Bengaluru; Meenakshi Temple opens early each morning.

places.name: Jerusalem, Mahane Yehuda market
places.why: The market's Friday rush, then its sudden quiet, shows how a week of work gives way to rest.
places.realVisit: Mahane Yehuda is in central Jerusalem, best on Friday before noon.

places.name: Tiberias
places.why: Maimonides, who wrote the steps of teshuvah, is buried in Tiberias, so the Jewish path of return is taught here.
places.realVisit: Tiberias is on the Sea of Galilee, about two hours from Tel Aviv by bus.

places.name: The Jabbok river
places.why: Jacob wrestled through the night and met his brother Esau beside the Jabbok.
places.realVisit: The Zarqa river valley is about an hour north of Amman by road.

places.name: Jerusalem, Pater Noster and Dominus Flevit
places.why: The Lord's Prayer and Jesus' words of forgiveness belong to the slopes above Jerusalem's old city.
places.realVisit: The Mount of Olives is a walk from the old city's Lions' Gate; the churches are free.

lessons.spot: Southern Steps of the Temple Mount
lessons.title: Neither do I condemn thee

places.name: Capernaum and Tabgha
places.why: Peter's town, where Jesus taught forgiving seventy times seven and later forgave Peter on the shore.
places.realVisit: Capernaum and Tabgha are on the north shore of the Sea of Galilee, a short drive from Tiberias.

places.name: Jericho
places.why: Zacchaeus climbed a sycamore in Jericho and gave back what he had taken.
places.realVisit: Jericho is reached by road from Jerusalem, about 40 minutes; check local travel advice.

places.name: Haarlem
places.why: Corrie ten Boom's family hid hunted people here, and she later forgave a former guard.
places.realVisit: The Corrie ten Boom House in Haarlem runs free guided tours; book ahead.

places.name: Nickel Mines, Lancaster County
places.why: After the 2006 school shooting, the Amish community here forgave the killer's family.
places.realVisit: Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, welcomes visitors; please respect the privacy of the Nickel Mines community.

places.name: Ta'if
places.why: Stoned out of Ta'if, the Prophet prayed for its people rather than for revenge.
places.realVisit: Ta'if is about two hours by road from Jeddah, with a tourist visa.

places.name: Varanasi, Kabir's quarter
places.why: Kabir lived and wove in this Varanasi quarter, singing that forgiveness is where God lives.
places.realVisit: Kabir Chaura Math is in central Varanasi, open to visitors.

places.name: Sravasti, Angulimala's stupa
